How to Download Rajasthan SET Result 2026 PDF?

The University of Kota has provided a downloadable result PDF containing the roll numbers of provisionally qualified candidates. No registration-number login is needed to open this PDF.

  2. Open the State Eligibility Test 2026 section.
  3. Click the SET Examination Result 2026 link.
  4. Open the official result and final answer-key page.
  5. Select Download Result PDF.
  6. Open the PDF document.
  7. Use the PDF search function to find your examination roll number.
  8. Check whether your roll number appears in the qualified candidates' list.
  9. Review the applicable subject and category cut-off details.
  10. Save the official PDF for reference.

Rajasthan SET Final Answer Key 2026

Along with the result, the University of Kota released the final answer keys for the Rajasthan State Eligibility Test 2026. These are available through a dedicated subject-wise download page.

The official page includes final answer keys for 37 subject entries, including Chemical Sciences, Commerce, Computer Science and Applications, Economics, Education, English, Geography, Hindi, History, Law, Management, Physical Education, Political Science, Psychology, Sociology and other notified subjects.

Geography and Physical Education include answer keys for both examination batches.

Download Rajasthan SET Final Answer Key 2026 - Subject-Wise PDFs

Rajasthan SET Marking Scheme 2026

The university's official result notice dated 6 November 2026 explains the marking scheme used for the SET examination result.

Marking Particulars Details
Marks Per Question 2
Correct Answer +2 Marks
Incorrect Answer No Negative Marking
Unattempted Question Not Evaluated
Questions Marked for Review Evaluated If Answered
Maximum Combined Marks 300

The official notification also explains the treatment of questions with multiple accepted answers or dropped questions. Candidates should refer to the university's result notice for the exact evaluation rules.

Rajasthan SET Normalisation 2026 - Geography and Physical Education

The University of Kota applied a scaling technique for the Geography and Physical Education subjects because these examinations were conducted in two shifts.

The official notice specifies Shift I as the standard shift for Geography and Shift II for Physical Education. The technique uses the mean and standard deviation of marks across examination shifts.

If the scaled score exceeds 300, the marks are restricted to 300. Candidates in these two subjects should consider this scaling process when interpreting their results.

Rajasthan SET Scorecard 2026 Download

The Rajasthan SET 2026 individual scorecard is separate from the already released roll-number result PDF.

According to the official university notice, qualified candidates will be able to download their scorecards after two weeks from the result declaration through their Rajasthan SSO ID login.

Scorecard Particulars Details

Individual Scorecard Available After Two Weeks
Expected Availability Period Around 20 November 2026

How to Download Rajasthan SET E-Certificate and Scorecard 2026?

After the University of Kota activates the individual download facility, qualified candidates can use their Rajasthan SSO account to obtain the applicable documents.

  1. Visit sso.rajasthan.gov.in.
  2. Log in using your registered Rajasthan SSO ID.
  3. Open the applicable SET-2026 service when available.
  4. Find the scorecard or e-certificate download option.
  5. Complete any additional verification requested.
  6. Check the candidate and qualification details.
  7. Download the available documents.
  8. Save copies for future Assistant Professor recruitment applications.

The specific SSO dashboard option will depend on the service activated by the university.

What Happens After Rajasthan SET Result 2026?

Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the result PDF have provisionally qualified the State Eligibility Test.

Qualifying the SET establishes the relevant eligibility for applying to Assistant Professor positions, subject to the applicable recruitment rules. It does not automatically provide a job, appointment letter or selection for a specific college vacancy.

Qualified candidates should obtain their e-certificates and scorecards when available and continue monitoring official recruitment announcements from the relevant institutions.

How to Check Kerala SET Result 2026

Candidates who appeared in the July 2026 session can check their qualifying status online in a few steps.

  1. Visit the official portal at lbsedp.lbscentre.in/setjul26.
  2. On the homepage, look for State Eligibility Test (SET) July 2026 and click the Result Published link under the quick links section.
  3. Click on Result Published to open the login page.
  4. Enter your roll number and click Submit.
  5. Your Kerala SET scorecard will appear on the screen with your qualifying status.
  6. Download the scorecard and take a printout for future use.

Forgot Roll Number or Unable to Log In?

The result page provides a Forgot Roll Number or Search Result option to help candidates who do not remember their roll number. Keep your admit card handy, as the roll number is printed on it. For further help, candidates can contact the LBS Centre helpline at 0471-2560311, 0471-2560312 and 0471-2560313 during office hours.

Details Mentioned on the Kerala SET Scorecard 2026

Check every detail on your scorecard carefully after downloading it. The scorecard includes the following information:

  • Candidate name
  • Roll number
  • Subject chosen for Paper II
  • Marks obtained in Paper I
  • Marks obtained in Paper II
  • Total marks
  • Qualifying status

If you notice any mistake in your details or marks, contact the LBS Centre through the official helpline numbers given above.

Kerala SET Qualifying Marks 2026

To qualify Kerala SET, a candidate must score the minimum marks in Paper I, in Paper II and in the overall aggregate. The minimum marks differ by category.

Category Paper I (Minimum) Paper II (Minimum) Total Aggregate (Minimum)
General 40% 40% 48%
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 35% 35% 45%
SC / ST / Differently Abled (PwD) 35% 35% 40%

What After Kerala SET Result 2026?

Candidates who have qualified Kerala SET should complete the following steps:

  1. Download your scorecard from the official portal and verify your qualifying status, paper-wise marks and aggregate.
  2. Apply for the Kerala SET certificate as per the instructions given in the result notification on the official portal. The exact last date and application procedure for the certificate: refer to the official result notification.
  3. Submit the application along with the required documents to the LBS Centre.
  4. Receive the SET certificate. The certificate is issued to qualified candidates within two months from the date of receipt of the application, provided there is no defect in the application.
  5. Use the certificate to meet the SET eligibility requirement for teaching posts in Kerala.

Documents to Keep Ready (Indicative)

No official post-result document checklist has been confirmed in the details available. The following list is indicative, and the official result notification on the portal will always prevail.

  • Printout of the Kerala SET scorecard
  • Admit card or roll number details
  • Valid photo identity proof
  • Category certificate, if you are claiming the lower qualifying marks for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), SC, ST or PwD category
  • Recent passport-size photographs

Is Kerala SET Result a Final Selection for a Teaching Job?

No. Kerala SET is a state-level eligibility test conducted by the LBS Centre for Science and Technology on behalf of the Government of Kerala. Qualifying it makes a candidate eligible for Higher Secondary School Teacher (HSST) posts and Non-Vocational Teacher posts in Vocational Higher Secondary Education (VHSE) in Kerala. The actual appointment depends on the separate recruitment process of the concerned appointing authority.

Since Kerala SET is not a recruitment exam, salary and vacancy details are Not Applicable to this result.

RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Merit List 2026 Selection Criteria

The Act Apprentice selection process is based on academic merit rather than a separate written examination or interview. Under the recruitment advertisement, the merit score is calculated using the simple average of the percentage marks obtained in Matriculation and the relevant ITI qualification.

For example, a candidate with 70% in Matriculation and 80% in ITI would have a combined average of 75% for the merit calculation.

Selection Factor Details
Academic Qualification Matriculation and Relevant ITI
Merit Calculation Simple Average of Matriculation and ITI Percentage Marks
Written Examination No
Interview No
Provisional Shortlisting Trade-Wise and Category-Wise
Next Stage Document Verification
Medical Fitness Mandatory Under Applicable Apprenticeship Rules

Candidates must satisfy the minimum qualification, age, reservation and certificate requirements prescribed in Recruitment Notice No. A-1/2026.

Why Has RCF Shortlisted More Candidates Than Available Apprentice Seats?

The provisional merit list for document verification has been prepared with reference to approximately 1.5 times the available seats in the applicable trade and category groups.

This allows RCF to verify candidate eligibility and documents before finalising apprenticeship engagement. It does not mean that every candidate appearing in the provisional list will receive a training slot.

The number of advertised training slots remains 734; the number of candidates called for verification is a separate figure.

Documents Required for RCF Kapurthala Apprentice DV 2026

Provisionally shortlisted candidates must carry their original documents along with one set of attested photocopies to the Technical Training Centre for verification.

Document Requirement
Online Application Form Printout / Hard Copy
Matriculation Certificate Must Support Date of Birth and Marks
ITI Certificate Issued by NCVT
Fee Payment Proof Where Applicable
Employment Exchange Registration Certificate Where Applicable
Caste Certificate Where Applicable
Disability Certificate Where Applicable; Issued by Civil Surgeon
Ex-Serviceman Discharge Certificate For Applicable Children of Ex-Servicemen Cases
Identity Proof Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence or Other Accepted Proof
Passport-Size Photographs Two Identical Photographs
Medical Fitness Certificate In Prescribed Annexure-A Format

Candidates should ensure that the details in their documents match the information supplied in the online application. Missing or invalid eligibility documents may affect their consideration for apprenticeship engagement.

RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Medical Fitness Certificate 2026

The RCF document-verification instructions require candidates to submit a medical fitness certificate in the prescribed format.

The certificate must be issued by a Government-authorised medical officer of a Central or State Government hospital, holding a gazetted position and not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon.

The certificate should contain the candidate's photograph with the required attestation and follow the prescribed Annexure-A format.

Candidates must satisfy the applicable medical fitness requirements under the Apprentices Act, 1961, and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, as amended.

RCF Kapurthala Apprentice NCVT ITI Certificate Requirement

The document-verification notice specifically requires an ITI certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT).

Candidates must present the original certificate corresponding to the trade for which they applied, along with the prescribed attested copy.

Applicants should verify that their trade, name and qualification particulars match their original online application before attending verification.

RCF Apprentice DV 2026 - Important Instructions

Candidates attending document verification should follow the RCF notice carefully. The most important instructions are:

  • Attend document verification on the date applicable to your trade.
  • Report within the prescribed verification hours.
  • Carry all original certificates.
  • Bring one set of attested photocopies.
  • Carry two identical passport-size photographs.
  • Submit the prescribed medical fitness certificate.
  • Carry the NCVT-issued ITI certificate.
  • Bring category, disability or other supporting certificates where applicable.
  • Do not assume that appearing in the provisional merit list guarantees engagement.
  • Make your own travel arrangements because TA/DA is not payable.

Is RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Merit List 2026 Final?

No. The list released in November 2026 is a provisional merit list for document verification.

Final apprenticeship engagement remains subject to verification of the original documents, educational qualifications, category and eligibility claims, and medical fitness.

Candidates who do not satisfy the prescribed conditions may not be considered for engagement even if their names appear in the provisional list.

Will RCF Provide Travel Allowance for Apprentice Document Verification?

No. According to the published document-verification instructions, candidates attending RCF Kapurthala Apprentice DV 2026 will not receive any daily allowance, conveyance allowance or travelling allowance.

Candidates should make their own arrangements for travelling to the Technical Training Centre, Kapurthala, and attending verification during the prescribed hours.

What Happens After RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Document Verification 2026?

After verification, RCF will determine the eligibility of provisionally shortlisted candidates according to the recruitment notice and applicable apprenticeship rules.

Further engagement will depend on the available training slots, verification results, medical fitness and other applicable conditions. Candidates should monitor the official RCF website for subsequent instructions.

  10. Finally submit the application within the prescribed deadline.

UPSC CSE Mains Result 2026 - Is This the Final Selection List?

No. The UPSC CSE Mains Result 2026 identifies candidates who have qualified the written examination and are eligible to proceed to the Personality Test, subject to fulfilment of the prescribed requirements.

How to Check WBSSC Group C and D Result 2026?

WBSSC Group C and D Interview Date 2026

The WBSSC Group C and D oral interview schedule will be announced separately. Both result notices dated 5 November confirm that the Commission will publish the prospective schedule through its website.

The preliminary interview list does not specify one common interview date for all shortlisted candidates.

Documents Required for WBSSC Group C and D Verification

The Commission requires physical verification of original testimonials, certificates and other relevant documents. Candidates should refer to their subsequent verification notice for the exact mandatory checklist.

Depending on eligibility and the instructions issued, candidates may need to prepare the following:

  • Written Examination Admit Card
  • Application or Registration Details
  • Proof of Date of Birth
  • Educational Qualification Certificates and Marksheets
  • Applicable Category or Reservation Certificates
  • Experience Certificate, if claimed

WBSSC Group C Selection Process 2026

Group C Clerk recruitment includes a written examination and further assessment under the relevant WBSSC non-teaching staff recruitment rules.

Recruitment coverage identifies academic qualification evaluation, applicable experience assessment, computer and typing proficiency and oral interview or verification requirements as part of the broader Group C selection process.

Candidates should follow the Commission's detailed rules and subsequent stage-specific notices, including any prescribed computer or typing assessment.

WBSSC Group D Selection Process 2026

For Group D recruitment, the written examination is followed by the additional recruitment assessments and verification requirements provided under the applicable rules.

The 5 November 2026 result notice specifically confirms the forthcoming physical verification and oral interview.

Final selection will be subject to the Commission's prescribed recruitment process and verification of eligibility.

Is WBSSC Group C and D Result 2026 Final?

No. The lists published on 5 November 2026 are expressly described by the West Bengal Central School Service Commission as Preliminary Interview Lists.

The lists identify candidates for further consideration in the recruitment process. They do not constitute the final selection panel, waiting list or appointment order.

Candidates must complete any subsequent verification, interview and other applicable recruitment requirements.

What Should Candidates Do After WBSSC Group C and D Result 2026?

Candidates whose names appear in the published preliminary interview lists should take the following steps:

  1. Download the correct Group C or Group D result PDF.

  3. Verify your region, medium and category.
  4. Check the marks and rank displayed against your entry.
  5. Review the applicable cut-off printed in your list section.
  6. Save a copy of the result document.
  7. Prepare the original educational, identity and applicable category documents.
  8. Monitor the Commission's website for the physical verification schedule.
  9. Check the oral interview notice after publication.

How to Download WBCS Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates can check their WBCS Preliminary Examination results by opening the result PDF and searching for their roll numbers.

  1. Visit the official WBPSC website at psc.wb.gov.in.

  3. Find the West Bengal Civil Service (Executive) etc. Preliminary Examination, 2024 result.
  4. Confirm Advertisement No. 08/2024 and the notice date of 5 November 2026.
  5. Open or download the result PDF.
  6. Press Ctrl + F on a computer or use the PDF search option on a mobile device.
  7. Enter your complete Preliminary Examination roll number.
  8. Check whether the roll number appears in the published list.
  9. Review the category-wise cut-off marks on the final page.
  10. Save the result notice for reference when preparing for the Main Examination.

How to Search Your Roll Number in WBCS Result PDF?

The result PDF contains thousands of roll numbers and does not require candidates to search through every page manually.

For quicker checking, use the search facility in your PDF viewer and enter the complete roll number exactly as printed on your WBCS admit card.

On a desktop computer, press Ctrl + F and type the roll number. On a smartphone, open the PDF in a reader that supports text search and use the search icon.

If no matching number appears, verify that the complete roll number was entered and that the correct WBCS Preliminary Examination 2024 result PDF has been opened.

Details Mentioned in WBCS Prelims Result 2026

The WBPSC result document is a roll-number-wise provisional qualification list. Candidates should not expect it to function as an individual scorecard.

The result notice includes:

  • West Bengal Civil Service (Executive) etc. Preliminary Examination, 2024
  • Advertisement No. 08/2024
  • Result Notice No. 399-PSC/CON
  • Result Publication Date - 5 November 2026
  • Total Qualified Candidates - 3,842
  • Roll Numbers of Provisionally Qualified Candidates
  • Category-Wise Cut-Off Marks
  • Explanatory Notes on Applicable Reservation Rules

The document does not provide individual marks against each qualified candidate's roll number.

WBCS Prelims Result 2026 - Official Reservation Rules

WBPSC has included explanatory notes concerning the application of reservation rules while preparing the WBCS Preliminary Examination result.

The result refers to the Backward Classes Welfare Department notifications governing OBC reservation, including Notification Nos. 944-BCW/MR-23/2026 and 945-BCW/MR-23/2026, both dated 18 May 2026, read with Notification No. 1060/Secy/BCW/7P-63/2024 dated 7 August 2026.

The result also refers to Labour Department Notification No. Labr/85-EmpIEC/1M-01/25 dated 25 May 2026 regarding the generic nature of PwBD roster points.

Candidates should refer to the exact explanatory notes in the official result PDF for the Commission's stated reservation provisions.

WBCS Selection Process 2026

The West Bengal Civil Service (Executive) etc. Examination follows a multistage selection process. The Preliminary Examination is a screening stage, and qualified candidates proceed to the Main Examination.

Stage Examination / Selection Process
Stage 1 Preliminary Examination
Stage 2 Final Written (Main) Examination
Stage 3 Personality Test, as applicable
Final Stage Preparation of Final Merit and Selection Lists Under Applicable Rules

The Preliminary Examination primarily determines eligibility to appear in the Main Examination. Final selection depends on performance in the relevant subsequent stages and the applicable service-specific recruitment rules.

WBCS Mains Exam Date 2026

The WBCS Main Examination date has not been announced in the Preliminary Examination result notice dated 5 November 2026.

A total of 3,842 candidates have qualified provisionally for the final written examination. WBPSC will issue further instructions regarding the Main Examination schedule and examination arrangements through its official website.

Main Examination Details Status
Examination WBCS Main Examination - 2024 Cycle
Preliminary Result Released on 5 November 2026
Candidates Provisionally Qualified 3,842

WBCS Main Examination Admit Card 2026

Candidates who have qualified for the Main Examination should regularly check the WBPSC website for instructions concerning admission to the next examination stage.

The Commission may issue a separate notice regarding the Main Examination timetable, e-admit-card availability and examination centre arrangements.

No confirmed Main Examination admit-card release date is specified in the 5 November result notice.

What to Do After WBCS Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the provisional result should begin preparation for the Main Examination while monitoring further notifications from WBPSC.

  1. Download the WBCS Preliminary Examination result PDF.
  2. Verify your complete examination roll number.
  3. Check the relevant category-wise cut-off marks.
  4. Read the explanatory notes in the result notice.
  5. Save the result PDF for future reference.
  6. Review the official Main Examination syllabus and scheme.
  7. Begin subject-wise preparation for the Main Examination.
  8. Monitor the official website for the examination timetable.
  9. Check for any form-fill-up or document-related instructions issued by WBPSC.
  10. Download the Main Examination admit card when the Commission activates the facility.

Is WBCS Prelims Result 2026 Final?

No. The result released on 5 November 2026 is a provisional list of candidates qualified for the WBCS Main Examination.

Qualifying the Preliminary Examination does not guarantee recruitment to the West Bengal Civil Service or any allied service.

Candidates must satisfy all applicable eligibility requirements and successfully complete the subsequent examination and selection stages.

The notice includes the roll numbers of 3,842 provisionally qualified candidates, category-wise cut-off marks and explanatory notes on reservation rules.

  9. Verify the educational score, total score and position shown in the list.
  10. Download or save the available result document if the portal provides that option.

If your district's merit-list entry is not currently available, check the portal again for subsequent district-wise updates.

Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

The Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 covers 6,843 vacancies distributed between Worker and Helper posts in the state's Anganwadi centres.

Post Name Vacancies
Anganwadi Worker (AWW) 3,043
Anganwadi Helper (AWH) 3,800
Total 6,843

These figures refer to the advertised recruitment vacancies, not the number of candidates whose names appear in a district-wise merit list.

How Is Gujarat Anganwadi Merit List 2026 Prepared?

The Gujarat Anganwadi recruitment follows a merit-based selection process instead of a written examination or interview. Candidates are assessed according to the relevant academic qualifications and local eligibility requirements.

Selection Factor Details
Anganwadi Worker Academic merit primarily based on Class 12 marks
Anganwadi Helper Academic merit primarily based on Class 10 marks
Higher Educational Qualifications Considered according to the applicable merit and tie-breaking rules
Local Residency Must satisfy the prescribed centre-specific local eligibility conditions
Written Examination Not Conducted
Interview Not Conducted

Local residency is particularly important because the recruitment concerns individual villages, wards and Anganwadi centres. Higher academic marks do not automatically make a candidate eligible for a centre where they do not fulfil the prescribed local-residency conditions.

Details Mentioned in Gujarat Anganwadi Merit List 2026

The district-wise merit records are reported to include candidate identity, centre details and academic scores. The available fields may vary according to the report displayed by the e-HRMS system.

Important details to check include:

  • District
  • Taluka or Block
  • Village or City
  • Anganwadi Centre
  • Ward Number, where applicable
  • Post Name or Position
  • Application Number
  • Candidate Name
  • Marital Status, where displayed
  • Educational Score
  • Total Merit Score
  • Selection or Merit Position, where displayed

Candidates should check the details printed against their own application numbers and refer to the department's correction or objection instructions if any discrepancy is identified.

Gujarat Anganwadi Merit List 2026 – Merit List and Reject List Difference

The official e-HRMS recruitment portal provides both merit and rejection-list functions. These serve different purposes during the recruitment process.

Merit List Reject List
Contains candidates assessed for merit according to recruitment rules Contains applications marked rejected under the applicable scrutiny process
May show academic scores and selection information May show rejection details or reasons, where published
Used to check merit and recruitment status Used to identify application rejection status
Available through the e-HRMS recruitment system Available through the e-HRMS recruitment system

Candidates should check both their merit-list status and any applicable rejected-application record. Inclusion in a merit list does not necessarily mean that a final appointment order has been issued.

Gujarat Anganwadi Application Status 2026

Applicants who are unable to find their names in the merit list should also check their application status through the official e-HRMS portal.

The website contains an Application Status function within its recruitment tools. Candidates should use the details requested by the system to review their application and any available scrutiny information.

Check Gujarat Anganwadi Application Status 2026

Gujarat Anganwadi Merit List 2026 Document Verification

Following the publication of merit records, selected or shortlisted applicants may be required to complete document verification or other recruitment formalities according to the relevant district authority's instructions.

Candidates should keep the documents supporting their application available. These may include:

  • Application Form or Application Number
  • Class 10 Educational Certificates
  • Class 12 Educational Certificates, where applicable
  • Identity Proof
  • Local Residence Proof
  • Applicable Category Certificates
  • Other Documents Requested in the Official District Notice

The exact document checklist, verification date and reporting venue have not been confirmed in the supplied merit-list . Candidates must follow the instructions applicable to their district and Anganwadi centre.

Gujarat Anganwadi Merit List 2026 Objection and Correction Process

If a candidate identifies an error in the published merit list, academic score, local area or application details, the candidate should check whether the relevant district authority has provided a formal correction or objection process.

No common statewide merit-list objection deadline has been verified in the reviewed for this update.

Candidates should therefore avoid relying on unofficial deadlines and must check the official e-HRMS portal or district-level recruitment instructions for any available grievance process.

Is Gujarat Anganwadi Merit List 2026 the Final Selection List?

Not necessarily. The publication of a merit list indicates the stage of academic merit assessment and ranking under the recruitment process.

Final engagement may remain subject to the applicable eligibility requirements, verification of documents, local-residency conditions and any subsequent instructions issued by the recruiting department.

Candidates should distinguish between merit-list inclusion, provisional selection and final engagement confirmation.

What Should Candidates Do After Gujarat Anganwadi Merit List 2026?

Candidates whose names or application numbers appear in a published merit list should check their details carefully and follow any further instructions issued through the official portal.

  1. Open the official e-HRMS Merit/Reject List facility.
  2. Select the correct district, local area and post.
  3. Find your application number or name.
  4. Verify your educational marks and total merit score.
  5. Check whether any provisional-selection status is displayed.
  6. Save a copy of the available merit record.
  7. Review the relevant district recruitment notices.
  8. Prepare the required educational and local-residency documents.
  9. Check for any document-verification or objection instructions.
  10. Wait for the official final selection or engagement update.

Gujarat Anganwadi Merit List 2026 Official Website

The Government of Gujarat's official e-HRMS website provides recruitment-related functions, including application submission, application status, merit/reject list and rejected-application list.

Candidates should use the official portal to verify recruitment status and avoid relying on unverified third-party selection lists.

SSC JHT Sliding Process 2026

The Staff Selection Commission has introduced a Sliding Mechanism to improve the filling of available vacancies and reduce vacancies remaining unfilled because of candidates not joining their allocated posts.

Under this mechanism, a further allocation process may be conducted according to the Commission's prescribed rules. Candidates provisionally recommended in the First Round of Tentative Allocation must participate in the related physical verification process.

Is SSC JHT Result 2026 Final?

No. The result declared on 5 November 2026 is the First Round of Tentative Allocation for the Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2025.

Inclusion in the current result list should not be treated as confirmation of final appointment.

RRC Jaipur Level 1 Result 2026 - Important Vacancy and Court Case Conditions

The Board has expressly stated that the result is subject to the applicable legal proceedings, recruitment provisions and further verification. It also reserves the right to correct inadvertent errors.

Candidates should not treat inclusion in the roll-number list as a guarantee of appointment.

How to Check RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026

  1. Visit the official RBI website, rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities Portal at opportunities.rbi.org.in.
  2. Go to the "Opportunities @ RBI" section and open "Current Vacancies" → "Results".
  3. Click on the link for the RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 (Panel Year 2025).
  4. Download the result PDF to your device.
  5. Open the PDF and press Ctrl+F to search for your roll number.
  6. If your roll number appears in the list, you have qualified for the Language Proficiency Test.

What After RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026?

Candidates shortlisted in the Mains Result must now appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT), the final stage of the RBI Assistant selection process. The LPT tests a candidate's ability to read, write, speak, and understand the official/local language of the RBI office for which they applied. Candidates who studied the relevant local language up to the 10th or 12th standard are generally exempted; others must appear for and clear the LPT to remain in contention for final selection. The LPT is qualifying in nature no marks from it are added to the final merit list, but clearing it is mandatory. RBI is yet to announce the exact LPT schedule, venue, and reporting-time details for this cycle; candidates should watch the official portal for this notification.

RBI Assistant Selection Process 2026

  • Preliminary Examination: Qualifying stage only. Prelims marks are not counted towards the final merit list.
  • Main Examination: The Mains score is what decides a candidate's final rank and selection.
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT): Qualifying stage. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the local/regional language of the RBI office applied for. There is no interview stage in this recruitment.

Details Required to Check SBI PO Score Card 2026

Important Instructions for SBI PO Score Card 2026

  • Cross-check the domain name in your browser address bar before entering personal details.
  • Download and save a copy of the score card for future reference, as it may be required at later stages of recruitment.
  • In case of login errors, this can occur due to incorrect details, heavy website traffic, or a temporary technical issue — wait and retry rather than repeatedly submitting incorrect information.

SBI PO Mains Exam 2026: Next Step

Candidates shortlisted through the SBI PO Prelims Result 2026 will appear for the SBI PO Mains Examination scheduled on 12th September 2026. The Mains exam includes both an objective test and a descriptive paper, with negative marking of 0.25 marks per wrong answer applicable to the objective section only. The SBI PO Mains Admit Card release date is Not Available Officially at the time of this update. Shortlisted candidates are advised to use their Prelims score card to identify weaker sections and focus preparation accordingly on reasoning, data analysis, English language, general/economy/banking awareness, and descriptive writing.

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination
  • Overall/aggregate marks

SBI Clerk Admit Card 2026: The State Bank of India (SBI) is set to release the admit card for the Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales)/Clerk (Backlog) written examination in the 2nd week of September 2026. This special recruitment drive, held under Advertisement Number CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16, aims to fill 1538 backlog vacancies reserved for SC, ST, and OBC candidates. The SBI Clerk Preliminary Examination is scheduled for 16 September 2026. As of now, the direct admit card download link is not yet live; it will be activated on the official SBI careers portal once released.

How to Download SBI Clerk Admit Card 2026

How to Download SBI PO Mains Admit Card 2026

Union Bank of India (UBI) has released the Union Bank of India SO Admit Card 2026 on 31 August 2026 for the online examination under the Union Bank Recruitment Project 2026-27. The recruitment covers 395 posts of Specialist Officer (SO), General Banking Officer (GBO) and Officers with Domain Expertise.

The online examination for these posts is scheduled for 6 September 2026. Candidates who successfully submitted their applications can download the Union Bank SO Call Letter using their registration credentials. This page provides the admit card download details, exam date, documents required at the exam centre, exam pattern and important instructions.

How to Download Union Bank of India SO Admit Card 2026

Union Bank of India has activated the call letter download facility for candidates appearing in the online examination. Follow these steps to download the Union Bank SO Admit Card 2026:

  1. Visit the official Union Bank of India website at unionbankofindia.bank.in.
  2. Open the Recruitment / Careers section.
  3. Find the link related to Union Bank Recruitment Project 2026-27.
  4. Click on the Online Examination Call Letter / Admit Card download link.
  5. You will be redirected to the designated examination login portal.
  6. Enter your Registration Number / Roll Number and Password / Date of Birth, as required.
  7. Enter the captcha or verification code displayed on the screen.
  8. Submit the login details.
  9. Your Union Bank SO Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
  10. Download the call letter and take a clear printout for the examination.

Candidates should retain the admit card safely until the recruitment process is completed.

Details Mentioned on the Union Bank SO Admit Card

Candidates should carefully verify the information printed on their admit card after downloading it.

The call letter may contain the following details:

  • Candidate's name
  • Roll number
  • Registration number
  • Post applied for
  • Post code
  • Online examination date
  • Reporting time
  • Gate closing time
  • Exam venue / centre name
  • Complete exam centre address
  • Candidate's photograph
  • Candidate's signature
  • Exam-day instructions and guidelines

Candidates should immediately contact the concerned authority through the official Union Bank recruitment portal if they find any discrepancy in their admit card details.

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

Candidates appearing for the Union Bank SO online examination should carry the required documents mentioned in their call letter.

These generally include:

  • Printout of the Union Bank SO Admit Card 2026
  • One valid original photo identity proof such as:
    • Aadhaar Card
    • PAN Card
    • Passport
    • Driving Licence
  • Passport-size photograph, preferably the same photograph uploaded during the application process, if required in the call letter
  • Photocopy of the photo ID proof, if instructed

Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted as valid photo identity proof.

Candidates should carefully read the instructions printed on their individual call letter because document requirements may vary.

Union Bank SO Recruitment 2026: Post & Vacancy Snapshot

Union Bank Recruitment Project 2026-27 covers a total of 395 vacancies for Specialist Officers, General Banking Officers and Officers with Domain Expertise.

The recruitment includes posts across scales from MMGS-II to TEGS-VI, covering Post Codes S01 to S108.

Vacancies are available across several professional domains, including:

  • Information Technology
  • Risk Management
  • Law
  • Forex
  • Credit
  • Data Science
  • Chartered Accountancy
  • Other specialist and domain-specific areas

Candidates should refer to the official recruitment notification for the complete post-wise and category-wise vacancy distribution.

Union Bank SO Exam Pattern 2026

Section Number of Questions Marks
Professional Knowledge (Post-specific) 75 150
General Aptitude – English Language, Quantitative Aptitude & Reasoning Ability 25 25
Total 100 175

The examination will be conducted in online mode.

There will be a negative marking of 1/4 mark for every incorrect answer.

The Professional Knowledge section will vary depending on the post for which the candidate has applied.

Important Instructions for Union Bank SO Exam 2026

Candidates should follow all instructions mentioned in their call letter.

  • Reach the examination venue well before the reporting time mentioned on the admit card.
  • Candidates may not be allowed to enter after the gate closing time.
  • Carry a printed copy of the admit card.
  • Carry an original valid photo identity proof.
  • Ensure that the name and other details on the identity proof match the information on the admit card.
  • Mobile phones, smart watches, calculators and other electronic devices are generally prohibited inside the examination hall unless specifically permitted.
  • Check the exam centre address before the examination day to avoid delays.
  • Read all instructions printed on the call letter carefully.
  • Keep the admit card safely until the recruitment process is completed.

SBI SCO Written Exam Date 23 August 2026

SBI SCO Admit Card 2026 Download Link

The admit card download link is active on the official SBI website from 12 August 2026 until the exam date, 23 August 2026. Candidates should download and print the call letter well before exam day rather than waiting until the last moment, since no admit cards are sent by post. It is also emailed and sent via SMS to the registered mobile number and email ID, but carrying a printed copy remains the candidate's own responsibility.

Direct Link to Download SBI SCO Admit Card 2026

How to Download SBI SCO Law Officer Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official SBI website at sbi.bank.in.
  2. Click on "Join SBI" and then select "Current Openings" from the homepage.
  3. Find the link for "Recruitment of Specialist Cadre Officer (Assistant Manager (Law) / Deputy Manager (Law)) On Regular Basis (Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/02)".
  4. Click on "Download the Call Letter for Online Exam".
  5. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth, then enter the captcha code.
  6. Click the "Login" button.
  7. Your SBI SCO Call Letter 2026 will appear on the screen.
  8. Download and take a clear printout to carry to the examination hall.

Details Mentioned on SBI SCO Admit Card 2026

After downloading the admit card, candidates should carefully verify every detail on it. Any discrepancy should be reported to SBI immediately, well before the exam date, to avoid last-minute issues.

  • Candidate Name
  • Registration Number and Roll Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Gender and Category
  • Candidate Photograph
  • Exam Date and Reporting Time
  • Exam Centre Name, Code, and Address
  • Name of the Exam Conducting Authority
  • Space for Candidate's and Invigilator's Signature
  • Important Exam Day Instructions

Documents Required Along with SBI SCO Admit Card 2026

  • Printed copy of the SBI SCO Admit Card 2026
  • One valid original photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence)
  • Photocopy of the same photo ID (as many exam centres require this to be submitted)
  • Two recent passport-size photographs (same as uploaded during application, as some centres request this check your specific call letter for centre-wise requirements)

Note: Exact document requirements can vary by exam centre. Always follow the instructions printed on your individual admit card, since these are the authoritative and final instructions for your centre.

SBI SCO Exam Day: Important Instructions

  • Reach the exam centre well before the reporting time mentioned on the admit card; late entry is generally not allowed once the gate closes.
  • Carry the admit card and a valid original photo ID entry may be denied without both.
  • No electronic devices, including mobile phones, smartwatches, or calculators, are permitted inside the exam hall.
  • Follow the specific stationery and dress code instructions printed on your admit card, if any.
  • SBI does not allow changes to the exam centre, date, or shift once the admit card is issued.
  • Keep the admit card safe after the exam, as it may be required again at the interview stage.

SBI SCO Selection Process 2026

Selection for the Assistant Manager (Law) and Deputy Manager (Law) posts is based on a written examination followed by an interview. The written exam includes objective and descriptive components; candidates need to clear the qualifying marks set for each section to move ahead in the process. Shortlisted candidates from the written exam are then called for a personal interview.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026: The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) has released Advertisement No. 06/2026 dated 6 November 2026 for recruitment of 1,260 Junior Engineer (Electric/Electrical), Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS), MTS General Duty and MTS Aaya (Female) posts across Delhi Government departments, autonomous bodies and local authorities. The recruitment includes 185 Junior Engineer vacancies and 1,075 MTS vacancies under Post Codes 809/26 and 810/26. Candidates with Class 10, ITI or Electrical Engineering degree/diploma qualifications can apply according to the applicable departmental requirements. The age limit is generally 18 to 27 years, with an upper limit of 32 years for the NDMC Junior Engineer post and applicable relaxations. The pay scales range from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 1,51,100, depending on the post. Online applications open on 12 November 2026 at 12:00 noon and close on 11 December 2026 at 11:59 PM through dsssbonline.nic.in.

Important: Junior Engineer qualifications and experience requirements vary by department. A diploma holder needs two years of relevant experience for certain departments, while other JE vacancies do not require previous experience. The MTS Aaya vacancies are specifically notified for female candidates. Applicants must satisfy the individual department's eligibility conditions as on 11 December 2026.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

The essential educational qualification differs between Junior Engineer and MTS posts. Candidates must meet the requirements of the department for which they seek consideration by 11 December 2026.

Can Fresh Engineering Graduates Apply for DSSSB JE 2026?

Yes. Eligible candidates with an Electrical Engineering degree can apply for the NDMC, MCD and Delhi Transco Limited vacancies without mandatory previous experience, subject to each department's qualification and age conditions.

However, the Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board and DUSIB specify a diploma-based qualification route. Applicants should not assume that every engineering qualification is accepted for every department without checking the applicable Recruitment Rules.

Can Diploma Holders Apply for DSSSB Junior Engineer?

Yes. Electrical Engineering diploma holders can apply, but experience requirements differ by department.

  • NDMC: Two years of professional Electrical Engineering experience required for diploma holders.
  • Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board: Two years of electrical installation or maintenance experience required.
  • MCD: Two years of professional experience as Electrical Engineer after completing the qualifying diploma.
  • Delhi Transco Limited: No essential experience required.
  • DUSIB: No essential experience required.

No previous work experience is prescribed as an essential requirement for the notified MTS vacancies.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Post Preference and Department Allocation

The notification provides a combined examination framework for each post code. Candidates who are shortlisted must submit their eligible department/post preferences when DSSSB opens the online e-dossier process.

  • Only departments for which the candidate meets all essential conditions should be selected.
  • Preferences become final after confirmation.
  • Candidates who fail to submit preferences within the notified period will not be considered for nomination/selection.
  • Department allocation is based on merit, available vacancies, reservation and submitted preferences.
  • No waiting panel will be maintained under the combined examination scheme.

Important: Candidates cannot claim another department after being allocated their first available preference according to merit. The department preferences should therefore be selected carefully.

  5. Enter the required personal information and Class 10 examination details.
  6. Provide an active email ID and mobile number.
  7. Complete the required verification and registration steps.
  8. Log in with the generated registration number and password.
  9. Open Advertisement No. 06/2026 and choose the relevant post code.
  10. Enter educational qualifications, experience and other required eligibility information.
  11. Enter reservation, category and age-relaxation information where applicable.
  12. Upload any documents requested during the application stage.
  13. Review the application form carefully before submission.
  14. Pay the prescribed Rs. 100 fee through SBI e-pay, if not exempt.
  15. Complete final submission before 11 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.
  16. Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

Important: Once an online application has been finally submitted, DSSSB does not permit changes or corrections, including changes to the candidate's category. Applicants should verify every detail before final submission.

DSSSB Reservation and Eligibility Rules 2026

OBC Reservation

Only candidates satisfying the notified OBC (Delhi) conditions are entitled to the applicable OBC reservation and age-relaxation benefits. OBC candidates from outside Delhi do not automatically qualify for those benefits.

EWS Reservation

EWS applicants must possess the prescribed Income and Asset Certificate valid for financial year 2026-27, issued on the basis of income for financial year 2025-26.

PwBD candidates must check whether their specific disability category is identified as suitable for the department and post. Suitability is not identical across all Junior Engineer departments.

The notice gives reservation as percentages, not as the number of posts in each category. Reservation follows the Union territory of Jammu & Kashmir Reservation Rules, 2005, as amended from time to time, and S.O. 176 dated March 15, 2024, issued by the Social Welfare Department, Civil Secretariat, J&K.

Category Reservation

Reservation for Persons with Disabilities

Under section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, the 4% reservation is divided as follows:

Disability Reservation
Blindness or low vision 1%
Deaf and Hard of hearing 1%
Locomotor disability including Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy 1%
Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness 1%

Multiple disabilities from amongst the above, including deaf-blindness, are also covered. Only persons with benchmark disability (not less than 40% of a specified disability) are eligible for reservation, and they must submit a disability certificate issued by a Competent Authority. PwBD candidates whose certificate shows the condition as "likely to improve" under the temporary disability category are not eligible for reservation; conditions marked "Progressive, non-progressive or not likely to improve" are treated as eligible.

  • A reserved category candidate who figures in the general list on own merit will not be adjusted against a reserved post; the original category stays unchanged.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Post Qualification Required
Probationary Officer Graduate in any discipline from a university recognized by Government of India or any other equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government/UGC, as on the last date of registration.

  • The candidate must hold a valid marks sheet/degree certificate showing graduation as on the last date of registration (26 November 2026).
  • The percentage of marks in Graduation, calculated to the nearest two decimals, must be entered while registering online. Where CGPA/OGPA is awarded, it must be converted into percentage, backed by a certificate from the appropriate authority on the University's conversion norms.
  • Percentage is total marks in all subjects of all semesters/years divided by aggregate maximum marks (including honours/optional/additional optional subjects) multiplied by 100. Fractions are ignored: 59.99% is treated as less than 60%.
  • A self-declaration of character and antecedents in a prescribed format is required. Candidature or appointment may be cancelled for material misrepresentation or conviction in a criminal offence involving moral turpitude.

Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Probationary Officer post.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Selection Process 2026

  1. Online Preliminary Examination
  2. Online Mains Examination (Objective & Descriptive)
  3. Interview

Preliminary Examination

Candidates must qualify in each of the three tests by securing cut-off marks decided by IBPS in concurrence with J&K Bank. The minimum aggregate qualifying marks are 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved category candidates, subject to overall merit. Candidates numbering 10 times the vacancies in each category are shortlisted for the Mains.

Mains Examination

Each candidate needs a minimum score in each test and a minimum total score. The minimum aggregate qualifying marks are 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved category, subject to overall merit. Only Mains marks count for shortlisting, and candidates numbering 3 times the vacancies in each category are called for interview. Mains scores are not shared before the interview process is completed.

Interview

The interview carries 100 marks, with minimum qualifying marks of 40% (35% for reserved category). The centre, venue, time and date will be given in the interview call letter, downloaded from https://jkb.bank.in/. The final merit score combines the Mains and the interview in the ratio 80:20, and candidates must qualify in both. Provisional selection is by category-wise merit against the vacancies in each category and will be notified on the Bank's website.

  • The medium of examination is English, and each test is separately timed.
  • The Descriptive Paper may be broadly based on economic and social issues, emerging trends in banking and technology, current events and ethics.
  • Negative marking: one fourth of the marks of a question is deducted for each wrong answer in the objective tests of both the Preliminary and Mains. No penalty for a blank question.
  • Scores from different sessions are normalized using the equi-percentile method, taken up to two decimal points.
  • J&K Bank reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination, which will be intimated through its website.

How to Apply Online for J&K Bank Probationary Officer Recruitment 2026

Applications are accepted online only from 07.11.2026 to 26.11.2026; no other mode is accepted. Before starting, keep scanned copies of the photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm, 20kb–50kb, 200 x 230 pixels preferred), signature in black ink (not in capital letters), left thumb impression on white paper, and the hand-written declaration in English, plus an active personal email ID and mobile number.

  1. Go to https://jkb.bank.in/, open the relevant notification under the "Careers" tab and click "APPLY ONLINE".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id; note the Provisional Registration Number and Password sent by Email and SMS.
  3. Validate the details and save with "Save & Next"; the form can be completed in more than one sitting.
  4. Upload the photograph and signature as per specifications, and capture a live photograph by webcam or mobile phone.
  5. Fill the other details of the application form, then preview the whole form.
  6. Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" after checking everything; no change is possible after this.
  7. Click the "Payment" tab, pay the fee online and click "Submit".
  8. Print the e-Receipt and the online Application Form containing fee details.

The hand-written declaration text is: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." A declaration written by anyone else or in another language makes the application invalid. Visually Impaired candidates who cannot write may type it and put their left thumb impression below.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Selected candidates must remain posted within the Zone first allotted for at least 5 years; no transfer outside that Zone is permitted on any ground before then.
  • No change of category is permitted after registration, and requests to be considered under another category will not be entertained.

  • Entry to the Preliminary and Mains needs the call letter and original photo identity proof with a photocopy; Mains candidates must also bring the stamped Preliminary call letter and stamped ID copy.
  • Accepted ID proofs include PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, college/university ID, Aadhaar/E-Aadhaar with photograph or Employee ID; Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted.

AFMS SSC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026: The Armed Forces Medical Services (AFMS) has released the detailed notification for recruitment of 120 Medical Officer posts under the Short Service Commission (SSC), including 90 vacancies for male candidates and 30 for female candidates. Indian citizens with a recognized MBBS qualification or an eligible postgraduate medical degree can apply, subject to the prescribed NEET PG, internship, medical registration and age requirements. MBBS candidates must have been born on or after 2 January 1997, while PG degree holders must have been born on or after 2 January 1992. Selected candidates will be commissioned as Captain or equivalent rank in the Navy or Air Force, with basic pay of Rs. 61,300 per month plus Military Service Pay and applicable allowances. Online applications are open from 9 November to 18 November 2026 through join.afms.gov.in.

Important: Applicants must have passed their final MBBS Part-I and Part-II examinations in not more than two attempts and completed their internship on or before 30 September 2026. The selection process uses NEET PG performance for interview shortlisting, followed by an interview and medical examination. Candidates pursuing a postgraduate degree must have their final PG results declared by 18 November 2026.

AFMS SSC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Overview

The official notification does not specify a separate examination date or written-test schedule. Interviews are tentatively planned to begin on 2 December 2026 at Delhi Cantt. Candidates should check the official website and registered email for updates.

AFMS Medical Officer Vacancy 2026 - 120 Posts

AFMS has announced 120 Medical Officer vacancies under the Short Service Commission, divided between male and female candidates.

The notification provides separate male and female vacancy allocations and separate merit lists for selection. It does not provide a further specialty-wise or social-category-wise vacancy breakup.

AFMS SSC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The Armed Forces Medical Services has issued the detailed 2026 recruitment notification for 120 Medical Officer (Short Service Commission) vacancies.

The six-page notification contains the complete eligibility requirements, NEET PG shortlisting formula, interview process, age conditions, application fee, salary, service tenure, promotion provisions and document requirements.

Official Recruitment Website: AFMS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026

The detailed notification should be accessed through the official recruitment portal. A separately verified public direct URL for the six-page PDF has not been established.

AFMS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must possess a medical qualification recognized under the National Medical Commission Act, 2019, and permanent medical registration with the competent medical council.

AFMS Medical Officer Educational Qualification

Requirement Details
Essential Medical Qualification MBBS Included in the National Medical Commission Act, 2019
MBBS Examination Attempts Final Part-I and II Passed in Not More Than Two Attempts
Postgraduate Qualification Recognized Medical PG Degree Accepted
Professional Registration Permanent State Medical Council / NMC / MCI Registration
Internship Completed on or Before 30 September 2026
PG Result for Candidates Pursuing PG Declared by 18 November 2026

Is NEET PG Mandatory for AFMS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?

The notification requires applicants to have appeared in NEET PG during 2025 or 2026, subject to its separate provision for civilian doctors holding postgraduate medical qualifications.

Existing civilian PG doctors are not required to appear in NEET PG again. Their previously obtained NEET PG marks will be considered for shortlisting.

Important: The notice does not impose a separate minimum NEET PG percentile for application eligibility. However, NEET PG performance is used to rank candidates for interview shortlisting.

Can MBBS Candidates Apply Without a Postgraduate Degree?

Yes. Candidates with a recognized MBBS degree can apply without MD, MS or another PG degree, provided they satisfy the MBBS attempt limit, internship completion, permanent registration, NEET PG and age conditions.

Can MD/MS or Other Eligible PG Doctors Apply?

Yes. Candidates holding recognized postgraduate medical qualifications can apply. Civilian PG doctors are covered by the notification's provision allowing previously obtained NEET PG marks to be used without appearing in NEET PG again.

Candidates still pursuing a PG degree must have their final result declared by 18 November 2026 and possess the required qualification documents for verification.

Is Internship Completion Mandatory?

Yes. Applicants must have completed their compulsory medical internship on or before 30 September 2026.

Candidates whose internships were completed after this deadline are not eligible under the notified conditions.

Can Candidates with More Than Two MBBS Final Examination Attempts Apply?

No. The notification requires candidates to have passed their final MBBS Part-I and Part-II examinations in not more than two attempts.

Applicants must submit the relevant final MBBS attempt certificate or transcript supporting this eligibility condition.

AFMS SSC Medical Officer Age Limit 2026

The age limit depends on whether the applicant holds an MBBS degree or an eligible postgraduate medical qualification. Age is assessed as on 31 December 2026.

Qualification Maximum Age Condition Eligible Date of Birth
MBBS Must Not Have Attained 30 Years Born on or After 2 January 1997
PG Medical Degree Must Not Have Attained 35 Years Born on or After 2 January 1992

Important: Candidates must use the qualification-specific age condition. The notification does not specify a separate category-wise age relaxation table.

AFMS SSC Medical Officer Salary 2026

Selected candidates will be commissioned in the rank of Captain or equivalent rank in the Navy or Air Force, under Level 10B of the Defence Pay Matrix.

The initial basic pay is Rs. 61,300 per month, with Military Service Pay of Rs. 15,500 and other applicable allowances.

Dress Allowance Rs. 25,000 Annually
House Rent Allowance As Applicable by Posting Location

Non-Practising Allowance (NPA) At Prevailing Rates

PG Allowance / Specialist Pay As Applicable to Eligible Designated Specialists

Salary Clarification: Rs. 76,800 represents the combined basic pay and Military Service Pay, not the final take-home salary. Applicable allowances, benefits, taxes and deductions depend on service rules and posting location.

Other AFMS Medical Officer Benefits

  • 60 days of annual leave.
  • 20 days of casual leave annually.
  • Leave Travel Concession (LTC).
  • Medical services for the officer and eligible family members, including dependent parents.
  • Group insurance.
  • Canteen Stores Department (CSD) facilities.
  • Subsidized accommodation and associated facilities, as applicable.
  • Ration or ration allowance under the applicable service conditions.
  • PG allowance or specialist pay for eligible officers.

Particulars Details

Payment Mode Online

Fee Refund Non-Refundable

Payment must be made at the end of the online application process. The payment transaction number should be saved and quoted in further recruitment-related enquiries.

AFMS SSC Medical Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection involves NEET PG-based shortlisting, interview, medical examination and preparation of separate male and female final merit lists.

  1. Online application and eligibility scrutiny.
  2. Shortlisting using calculated NEET PG marks.
  3. Viva-voce / Personal Interview.
  4. Special Medical Examination Board.
  5. Final merit list preparation.
  6. Joining instructions for medically fit candidates selected against available vacancies.

How Are NEET PG Marks Calculated for AFMS Shortlisting?

AFMS converts the candidate's NEET PG percentile into a score out of 200 for interview shortlisting.

Calculated NEET PG Marks = NEET PG Percentile × 2

NEET PG Percentile Calculated Marks out of 200
90 180
85 170
75 150
60 120

The above values are illustrative applications of the official calculation formula, not actual selection cut-offs.

If the original NEET PG result was declared using an absolute score, AFMS will first determine the percentile based on the candidate's merit position and then calculate the equivalent marks out of 200.

Separate shortlisting lists are prepared for male and female candidates.

AFMS Medical Officer Interview Pattern 2026

The interview carries a maximum of 50 marks, including weightage for the highest applicable NCC certificate.

Component Maximum Marks
Viva-voce Assessment 47
NCC Certificate Weightage Up to 3
Total 50

AFMS NCC Certificate Weightage

NCC Certificate Marks
NCC 'A' Certificate 1
NCC 'B' Certificate 2
NCC 'C' Certificate 3

Only the highest eligible NCC certificate is considered. Candidates cannot add the marks for A, B and C certificates together.

AFMS Interview Minimum Qualifying Marks

Candidates must obtain at least 50% of the interview marks, equivalent to 25 out of 50, to qualify for further consideration.

Qualifying in the interview does not automatically guarantee selection or commissioning.

How Is the AFMS Final Merit List Prepared?

The final merit list combines the calculated NEET PG marks out of 200 and interview marks out of 50, giving a maximum combined score of 250.

Merit Component Maximum Marks
Calculated NEET PG Marks 200
Interview Including NCC Weightage 50
Total 250

Separate male and female merit lists are prepared. Joining instructions are issued to selected candidates who are declared medically fit, according to the available vacancies.

AFMS Medical Officer Interview Date and Venue 2026

Interviews are tentatively scheduled from 2 December 2026 onwards at Army Hospital (Research & Referral), Delhi Cantonment.

Particulars Details
Interview Venue Army Hospital (R&R), Delhi Cantt
Interview Start Date 2 December 2026 (Tentative)
Interview Mode In Person
Interview Admit Card Available at Least One Week Before Interview Commencement
Official Website join.afms.gov.in

Is Travelling Allowance Provided for Interviews?

Candidates attending an AFMS interview for the first time are eligible for the prescribed to-and-fro AC III / AC Chair Car railway fare or Government non-AC bus fare from their normal place of residence.

No travelling allowance is payable to candidates residing within the municipal limits of the interview location.

AFMS Medical Officer Medical Examination 2026

Interview-qualified candidates must undergo a medical examination by the Special Medical Examination Board (SMB) constituted by the Directorate General Armed Forces Medical Services.

Candidates declared medically unfit may seek an Appeal Medical Board according to the prescribed procedure. A Review Medical Board may be permitted at the discretion of DGAFMS.

Final medical fitness is established only after approval of the medical examination documents.

AFMS SSC Medical Officer Tenure 2026

The initial Short Service Commission tenure for fresh civilian entrants is five years.

Service Period Duration
Initial SSC Tenure 5 Years
First Possible Extension 5 Years
Second Possible Extension 4 Years
Maximum Total Under Notified Extension Framework 14 Years

Extensions depend on willingness to continue, availability of vacancies, eligibility and applicable service policies. Extension is not automatic.

Can AFMS SSC Medical Officers Obtain Permanent Commission?

Eligible SSC officers may receive opportunities to appear for the Departmental Permanent Commission examination under the applicable rules.

The notification provides up to three chances after completing two years of service and before completing nine and a half years, subject to the prescribed eligibility conditions and attempt restrictions.

Important: Permanent Commission is not guaranteed by selection into the SSC Medical Officer recruitment.

AFMS Medical Officer Career Progression

Rank Eligibility / Service Requirement
Captain or Equivalent On Commissioning
Major or Equivalent After 4 Years of Eligible Service
Lieutenant Colonel or Equivalent After 11 Years of Eligible Service

Promotions are subject to the applicable service and eligibility conditions. The notification also describes further career progression under Permanent Commission and opportunities for postgraduate and super-specialty training according to service rules.

AFMS SSC Medical Officer Apply Online 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for 120 AFMS Medical Officer vacancies between 9 November and 18 November 2026.

Apply Online: AFMS Official Recruitment Portal

Application Last Date: 18 November 2026.

Application Processing Fee: Rs. 200.

Applications are accepted online only. Candidates should complete registration, upload the required medical and identity documents, pay the processing fee and retain the submitted application details.

How to Apply Online for AFMS SSC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official recruitment portal at join.afms.gov.in.
  2. Read the Medical Officer (Short Service Commission) Recruitment 2026 notification.
  3. Click NEW REGISTRATION.
  4. Follow the registration instructions displayed on the website.
  5. Enter the required personal and contact details.
  6. Provide the prescribed MBBS and postgraduate qualification information, where applicable.
  7. Enter medical registration and internship completion information as requested.
  8. Provide NEET PG examination information according to the notified eligibility provisions.
  9. Upload the required photograph and documents.
  10. Review the entered details and supporting certificates carefully.
  11. Pay the non-refundable Rs. 200 application processing fee through the available online payment method.
  12. Complete the online application submission by 18 November 2026.
  13. Save the payment transaction number.
  14. Download and retain the completed application form and available acknowledgement.
  15. Monitor the official website and registered email for shortlisting and interview instructions.

Important: Applicants must ensure that their online information agrees with the original documents. Incorrect, incomplete or unsupported information can result in rejection.

Documents Required for AFMS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026

Candidates must upload the prescribed documents while applying and produce original records with two photocopies during the interview verification process.

Documents Required for Online Application

Document Requirement
Passport-Size Photograph JPEG, Up to 100 KB, Not Older Than 6 Months
Class 10 Certificate / Municipal Birth Certificate PDF, Up to 200 KB, English-Language DOB Proof

Documents Required During AFMS Interview

  • Downloaded interview admit card and application form.
  • Original Class 10 certificate or accepted municipal birth certificate.
  • Aadhaar card.
  • Permanent medical registration certificate.
  • Internship completion certificate.
  • MBBS degree certificate and PG degree certificate, if applicable.

  • National Board of Examinations certificate for Foreign Medical Graduates, where applicable.
  • Passport for Foreign Medical Graduates, where applicable.
  • Gazette notification or supporting document for a name change after Class 10, where applicable.
  • Ten recent passport-size photographs.
  • Photo identification and address proof.
  • Five completed and duly attested copies of the prescribed attestation form.

Candidates must bring the original documents and two photocopies of each applicable certificate. Where an original document is deposited with another institution, the specific deposit-certificate and attested-copy procedure in the notification applies.

AFMS Attestation Form Requirement

Candidates must bring five copies of the prescribed attestation form, completed and attested by the competent authority, as specified in the official instructions.

Failure to provide the prescribed attestation forms may result in rejection at the interview stage.

AFMS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • AFMS has announced 120 SSC Medical Officer vacancies.
  • 90 vacancies are for male candidates and 30 for female candidates.
