Trade Apprentice (Accountant) Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Govt. recognized Institute/University.
Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices) Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate), and a Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year, issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Govt.

Disciplines accepted for Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation):

  • Electronics & Communication Engineering
  • Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
  • Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering
  • Instrumentation & Control Engineering
  • Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering
  • Electronics Engineering
  • The qualification must already be passed on 30.11.2026, the date for reckoning eligibility. Candidates whose result is awaited on that date are not eligible.
  • The Graduate/Diploma qualification must be a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline from a recognized University/Institute, with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for SC/ST and PwBD candidates for the posts reserved for them).

The notice also lists the PwBD categories (minimum 40% disability) for which each trade is suitable. The disability certificate must be in terms of Rule 18(1) and 20 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017, in Form V, VI or VII.

Trade Suitable disabilities
Technician Apprentice (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) Leprosy cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack victims; multiple disabilities from amongst these
Trade Apprentice (Accountant) Hard of Hearing; Musculoskeletal (One Leg, Both Legs), Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims; multiple disabilities from amongst these
Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource) Low Vision; Hard of Hearing; Musculoskeletal (One Arm, One Leg, Both Legs, One Arm & One Leg), Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims; multiple disabilities from amongst these
Data Entry Operator and Domestic Data Entry Operator Hard of Hearing; Musculoskeletal (One Leg, Both Legs), Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims; multiple disabilities from amongst these

Age

Minimum 18 years and maximum 24 years as on 30.11.2026, which is the date for reckoning any eligibility criteria. The upper age limit is relaxed as follows.

Category Relaxation
SC/ST (against reserved positions) Up to 5 years
OBC (NCL) (against reserved positions) Up to 3 years
PwBD (irrespective of reservation of posts) Up to 10 years
PwBD belonging to SC/ST Further 5 years
PwBD-OBC (NCL) Further 3 years

Who Cannot Apply

  • Candidates whose qualification was acquired through part-time, correspondence or distance education.
  • Candidates with higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA or equivalent, or pursuing a higher qualification and having completed it on or before joining apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates who have undergone apprenticeship training earlier or are pursuing it under the Apprentices Act.
  • Candidates with training and/or job experience of one year or more after attaining the qualification.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on 30.11.2026.
  • Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code; such applications will be summarily rejected.

Reservation

Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer)/PwBD/EWS candidates is as per the applicable Govt. guidelines. The minimum qualification marks are relaxed by 5% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates considered against reserved positions. If EWS seats in a trade cannot be filled from EWS candidates, they may be filled by unreserved category candidates on the basis of position in the Panel cum Merit List. SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for an Unreserved seat are considered on the standards applicable to General category candidates. For OBC (NCL), the caste named in the certificate must be in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State, and the Non-Creamy Layer status must be valid on the cut-off date.

Candidates should refer to the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each trade.

Stipend and Training Period

The apprenticeship lasts 12 months from the date of engagement. The monthly stipend is as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, the Apprentices Rules 1992/2019 as amended from time to time, and the Corporation's guidelines. During the apprenticeship no other monetary or non-monetary benefit such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance or medical facility is admissible; apprentices arrange these themselves. The terms of engagement are governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended. On completion, the Corporation has no obligation to offer employment, and an apprentice cannot claim employment on that ground.

How to Apply for IOCL Recruitment 2026

Applying is a two-portal process. The NAPS/NATS application must come first, before registering on the Indian Oil Pipelines portal. No other mode of application is accepted.

  1. Register as an apprentice on the portal for your trade: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in (NAPS) for Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices) and Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders); https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php (NATS) for the three Technician Apprentice trades and for Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant).
  2. Log in with your User ID/Email ID and apply for the opening with the Establishment ID of IOCL for your region, between 06.11.2026 and 05.12.2026. Check that your personal details, educational details, category and aggregate percentage show correctly; corrections are made through the NAPS/NATS office.
  3. Register on the Indian Oil Pipelines portal https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ using the same email ID and mobile number as on NAPS/NATS; both must stay valid for the whole apprenticeship period.
  4. In Part-I, enter basic details such as name and category and create a password. A registration number is sent to your email ID/SMS; log in again with it and your password.
  5. In Part-II, upload a scanned colour photograph (20-50 KB, JPG) and signature in black ink (10-30 KB, JPG), enter educational qualification and experience details, and submit. This is the final submission and details cannot be changed afterwards.
  6. Mention the NAPS/NATS registration/enrolment number in the Indian Oil Pipelines portal, and complete this application by 05.12.2026.
  7. Take a printout of the filled-in online application.
Region Establishment ID for NATS Establishment ID for NAPS
Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) EWBKOC000079 E11181900005
Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) WGJRAC000006 E11182400087
Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) NHRPPC000001 E12180600006
Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) STNCHC000040 E12183300008
South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) EORBBSC000001 E02252100002

The portal also hosts FAQs/How to apply options, and the disability certificate format, caste/tribe/EWS certificate formats and the pre-engagement medical guidelines are under its Downloads section.

Selection Process

Selection is by a Panel cum Merit List, followed by document verification and medical fitness. There is no written test or personal interview.

Panel cum Merit List

All applicants for a post who meet the eligibility criteria are ranked in descending order of the percentage of marks (aggregate of all subjects of all years/semesters) in the essential qualification for the trade applied. Where CGPA/OGPA or letter grade is awarded, the equivalent aggregate percentage must be entered in the application. A certificate from the Board/University/Institute stating the equivalent percentage must be uploaded and produced at document verification, otherwise candidature is not considered. If the Board does not follow a conversion formula, a certificate to that effect is needed, and the aggregate grade score of each semester/year divided by the number of semesters/years is considered. Ties go to the older candidate, and if the date of birth is also the same, to the higher Matriculation percentage. Candidates are shortlisted purely on the information furnished in the online portal.

Document Verification and Medical Fitness

The list of candidates provisionally selected for Document Verification and Medical Fitness will be published on the IOCL website. Candidates receive a link on their registered email to give their preference for the place of document verification and three preferences for the place of apprenticeship training in the applied State (wherever applicable). Allotment of the training place is based on merit. Originals are verified before joining, and an offer of engagement is issued only to candidates whose documents, including the medical fitness certificate, are in order.

Documents Required

At document verification, bring the originals with a self-attested copy of each, plus a passport size photograph and self-attested copies of certificates/mark sheets:

  • Xth Standard/Matriculation certificate/mark sheet from the Education Board, as proof of date of birth (no other document is accepted for date of birth).
  • Latest caste certificate in the Government prescribed proforma, issued by the Competent Authority, for reserved category candidates.
  • For OBC-NCL: latest caste certificate not more than 12 months old from 30.11.2026, in the Govt. of India proforma, stating the candidate is not in the creamy layer.
  • Semester-wise/year-wise mark sheets of ITI (NCVT/SCVT)/HSC/Graduation/Diploma in Engineering.
  • Final ITI (NCVT/SCVT) Certificate/HSC/Graduation/Diploma in Engineering from the Board/Authority/Institute.
  • First page of the Bank passbook of an Aadhaar seeded account, Aadhar Card, PAN Card and a cancelled cheque leaf.
  • Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of opening of online application 06.11.2026
Cut-off date for age, qualification and eligibility 30.11.2026
Last date of submission of online application 05.12.2026

Important Instructions

  • Incomplete applications, those received by any other mode, those not meeting eligibility and those received after the last date are treated as rejected. Canvassing of any kind disqualifies the candidate.
  • Candidature is provisional. Incorrect, false or suppressed information cancels candidature, and engagement is liable to be terminated if it is found after engagement.
  • Engagement is subject to medical fitness as per IndianOil's pre-engagement standard. Persons with benchmark disabilities, except for the identified disability, must be within the normal range of all other physical standards.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used per candidate, and the same ones cannot be used by another candidate for this notification.
  • Suppression of information on possessing or pursuing a higher qualification makes a candidate ineligible at any stage, and engagement can be terminated at any time.
  • Mere application, document verification or empanelment gives no right of engagement. Seats may remain unfilled for unsuitability or insufficient candidates, and the management's decision is final.
  • Disputes fall under the sole jurisdiction of the courts at Kolkata (ERPL), Ahmedabad (WRPL), Chandigarh (NRPL), Chennai (SRPL) and Cuttack (SERPL).
  • Queries relevant to the advertisement, and not already answered in it, go to the regional email: [email protected], [email protected], [email protected], [email protected] or [email protected].
  • All corrigenda, addenda and updates will appear only on https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships.

Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) has released the ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification for 3,047 apprenticeship seats across various trades and disciplines. Eligible candidates with Class 10, Class 12, ITI, Diploma or Graduation qualifications, depending on the trade, can apply online through the NAPS or NATS apprenticeship portals.

The online application process started on 29 October 2026 and will close on 20 November 2026. Candidates aged 18 to 24 years can apply, subject to the prescribed age relaxation, qualification and work-centre eligibility conditions. Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300 during the 12-month training period.

The apprenticeship training period is 12 months for all trades. ONGC will not provide transportation, boarding or lodging expenses. Apprenticeship engagement does not guarantee regular employment with ONGC.

ONGC Apprentice Selection Process 2026

Selection for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on the marks obtained in the prescribed qualifying examination. A provisional merit list will be prepared separately for the relevant trades, disciplines and work centres.

  1. Application Scrutiny: Verification of eligibility, academic qualifications, age and other requirements.
  2. Provisional Merit List: Prepared based on marks in the qualifying examination.
  3. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates and required supporting documents.
  4. Final Merit List: Prepared after eligibility and document verification, considering applicable reservation provisions.
  5. Engagement Formalities: Selected candidates must complete the required registration, document and medical fitness formalities.

If two candidates have equal merit marks, the older candidate will receive preference. The notification does not prescribe a separate written recruitment examination.

ONGC Apprentice Work Centre Eligibility 2026

Candidates are eligible for a particular ONGC work centre only if they are residents of an eligible district or have obtained their prescribed educational qualification from an eligible district.

For example, the Chennai work centre covers all districts of Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, while the Hazira work centre specifies Surat, Navsari, Tapi, Dang and Valsad districts. Other locations have their own eligibility conditions.

Applicants should consult Annexure I of the official notification before choosing a work centre. A candidate should apply for one trade at one work centre, as directed in the application instructions.

How to Apply Online for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) or National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal, depending on their chosen trade. Offline applications are not accepted.

  1. Read the official ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 advertisement and verify your eligibility.
  2. Check the required educational qualification and eligible districts for the chosen work centre.
  3. For NAPS trades, visit apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
  4. For NATS trades, visit nats.education.gov.in.
  5. Complete the required portal registration or sign in to your existing account.
  6. Find the relevant ONGC apprenticeship opportunity for your eligible trade and work centre.
  7. Fill in the required details and complete the application according to the portal instructions.
  8. Submit the application before 20 November 2026 and retain your registration and application details for future reference.

Important: Applications submitted by post, by hand or through any other offline mode will not be accepted. Ensure that the correct apprenticeship scheme and eligible work centre are selected.

ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

The online application process is open from 29 October to 20 November 2026. Eligible candidates should apply through the appropriate portal:

  • NAPS Apprentices: Apply through NAPS Portal
  • NATS Apprentices: Apply through NATS Portal

Candidates can check recruitment updates, selection lists and other notifications through the official ONGC apprenticeship website.

Age relaxation is subject to the conditions and supporting certificate requirements specified in the advertisement. Candidates must not automatically combine multiple relaxations unless permitted.

Indian Bank Apprentice Stipend 2026

Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000 in Metro/Urban branches or Rs. 12,300 in Rural/Semi-Urban branches during the 12-month training period.

Indian Bank Apprentice Branch-Wise Stipend

Branch Location Monthly Stipend Bank Component Government Component

Rural / Semi-Urban Rs. 12,300 Up to Rs. 6,150 Up to Rs. 6,150

Stipend Clarification: The stipend is not a regular bank employee salary. Apprentices are not eligible for additional allowances or regular employee benefits under this engagement.

Indian Bank Apprentice Training Duration 2026

The apprenticeship duration is 12 months of on-the-job training under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

Particulars Details
Training Period 12 Months
Training Type On-the-Job Training
Training Location Allotted Indian Bank Branch
Casual Leave 1 Day on Completion of Each Month
Maximum Casual Leave at a Time 4 Days
Overtime Not Permitted
Regular Employment Guarantee No

Indian Bank Apprentice Leave and Certification Rules

Apprentices are entitled to bank holidays and one casual leave after completing each month of training. A maximum of four casual leaves may be taken at one time.

The notification requires more than 338 paid days during the 12-month period to become eligible for the Certificate of Proficiency, subject to the prescribed assessment and completion conditions.

After successful training and assessment, the Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) will issue a digital Certificate of Proficiency through NATS 2.0.

Is Indian Bank Apprenticeship a Permanent Job?

No. Apprenticeship is a fixed-duration training arrangement. Indian Bank has no obligation to provide regular or contractual employment after completion of training, and apprentices do not have a right to claim employment with the bank.

Indian Bank Apprentice Application Fee 2026

The application fee is Rs. 800 plus GST for General, OBC and EWS candidates. SC, ST and PwBD candidates must pay Rs. 175 plus GST.

Category Application Fee

OBC Rs. 800 + GST

ST Rs. 175 + GST
PwBD Rs. 175 + GST

Fee Payment Period: 5 November to 25 November 2026.

Payment Mode: Online through Debit Card, Credit Card or Internet Banking using the available payment gateway.

The application fee is non-refundable. Applicable bank transaction charges are additional.

Indian Bank Apprentice Selection Process 2026

The selection procedure includes an online objective examination and a Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT). Indian Bank may also conduct an interview at its discretion.

  1. NATS Registration: Eligible candidates complete their apprenticeship registration and profile.
  2. Online Application: Candidates submit the application and pay the applicable fee.
  3. Online Written Test: Candidates appear in the 100-mark objective examination.
  4. Local Language Proficiency Test: Qualified candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the selected State/UT language unless exempt.
  5. Interview, If Conducted: The bank may include or dispense with an interview.
  6. Merit List: Candidates are ranked according to the applicable State/UT and category-wise merit rules.
  7. Document Verification: Eligibility and supporting certificates are verified.
  8. Medical Fitness: Engagement is subject to the bank's prescribed medical fitness requirements.
  9. Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates receive their digital engagement through NATS 2.0.

Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026

The online examination consists of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks, with a composite duration of 60 minutes.

Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Qualifying Marks

Indian Bank will determine the minimum qualifying marks on the aggregate examination score. There are no separate minimum qualifying marks for individual sections.

SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates receive a 5% relaxation in the prescribed aggregate qualifying percentage.

How Is the Indian Bank Apprentice Merit List Prepared?

The bank will prepare merit lists State/UT-wise and category-wise according to online examination performance.

Candidates will be ranked in descending order of aggregate marks. If candidates have identical marks at the cut-off, the older candidate will receive preference.

Where examinations are conducted in multiple sessions, scores will be normalized using the equi-percentile method.

A State/UT-wise and category-wise waiting list may also be prepared to fill unoccupied apprenticeship seats.

Indian Bank Apprentice Local Language Test 2026

Candidates must be able to read, write, speak and understand one of the specified local languages of their selected State or Union Territory.

The Local Language Proficiency Test will be conducted after the online examination. Candidates who fail to qualify will not be engaged as apprentices.

Who Is Exempt from the Indian Bank Local Language Test?

Candidates who provide Class 8, Class 10 or Class 12 marksheets or certificates proving they studied their selected local language are exempt from appearing in the Local Language Proficiency Test.

Important: Candidates without the prescribed language-study evidence must qualify in the LLPT. The test will be held at a centre decided by the bank in the relevant State/UT, and candidates must bear their own travel expenses.

Indian Bank Apprentice State and District Preference 2026

Applicants can apply for only one State or Union Territory. During registration, candidates may choose three preferred districts within the selected State/UT.

The bank gives the applicant's resident district the first preference in the applicable merit arrangement, while candidates may select two additional neighbouring districts.

Important: District preferences do not guarantee posting in a particular branch or district. Indian Bank may allot candidates to any district within their selected State/UT according to availability and operational requirements.

Indian Bank Apprentice Apply Online 2026

Eligible candidates can apply for the 1,500 Indian Bank apprenticeship training seats from 5 November to 25 November 2026.

Apply Online: Click Here

Indian Bank Careers: Indian Bank Official Recruitment Website

Application Last Date: 25 November 2026.

Important: Candidates must complete their NATS profile fully and submit the Indian Bank apprenticeship application. Merely registering on NATS without completing the recruitment-specific application is not sufficient.

How to Apply Online for Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

Step 1 - Register on NATS 2.0

  1. Visit the official NATS website at nats.education.gov.in.
  2. Open the Student Registration facility.
  3. Complete the enrolment process using the information requested on the portal.
  4. Enter accurate personal, contact and educational qualification details.
  5. Provide graduation passing information and other required certificates.
  6. Complete all mandatory profile sections until the NATS profile shows 100% completion.
  7. Save the generated NATS Enrolment ID.

Step 2 - Apply for Indian Bank Apprenticeship 2026

  1. Visit Indian Bank Careers or the NATS portal.
  2. Locate the recruitment titled Engagement of Apprentices in Indian Bank - 2026.
  3. Read the detailed advertisement and verify the qualification, graduation passing date, age and experience restrictions.
  4. Open the corresponding online application facility.
  5. Click New Registration if registering for the recruitment for the first time.
  6. Enter your name, contact details and email address.
  7. Note the provisional registration number and password.
  8. Use the Save and Next facility while completing the application.
  9. Enter the required personal, address, graduation and category details.
  10. Select one eligible State/UT.
  11. Choose the preferred districts within that State/UT.
  12. Select one of the prescribed local languages for the language proficiency requirement.
  13. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  14. Complete the additional details requested by the application form.
  15. Open the Preview tab and carefully verify all entered information.
  16. Select Complete Registration after confirming the details.
  17. Pay the applicable fee through the online payment facility.
  18. Complete the application by 25 November 2026.
  19. Save the application printout and payment confirmation for future reference.

Important: Once the application is finally submitted, changes to the submitted details will not be permitted. Candidates should ensure that their name, date of birth and educational details match their official certificates.

Documents Required for Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Candidates should keep the following documents and records available for registration, application and subsequent verification, as applicable.

  • Graduation degree certificate and marksheets.
  • Proof showing the graduation result was declared on or before 1 November 2026.
  • Date-of-birth proof.
  • Valid identity proof.
  • NATS 2.0 Enrolment ID.
  • Recent passport-size colour photograph.
  • Scanned signature.
  • Left thumb impression.
  • Handwritten declaration.
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS category certificate, if applicable.
  • PwBD disability certificate or UDID card, where applicable.
  • Class 8, 10 or 12 certificate showing study of the selected local language, if claiming LLPT exemption.
  • Other applicable documents requested by the bank during verification.

Photograph, Signature and Declaration Upload Size

Document Preferred Dimensions File Size
Photograph 200 x 230 Pixels 20 KB - 50 KB
Signature 140 x 60 Pixels 10 KB - 20 KB
Left Thumb Impression 240 x 240 Pixels 20 KB - 50 KB
Handwritten Declaration 800 x 400 Pixels 50 KB - 100 KB

Documents must be uploaded in the prescribed JPG/JPEG format. Candidates must also capture a live photograph through a webcam or mobile phone using the application portal's facility.

Indian Bank Apprentice Handwritten Declaration 2026

The handwritten declaration must be written in English on white paper using black ink. It must be written in the candidate's own handwriting and must not be written entirely in capital letters.

The official declaration is:

I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.

Candidates should reproduce the declaration exactly as prescribed in Annexure II of the official notification.

Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Centres 2026

The online examination will be conducted at various centres across India. The tentative examination centre list is provided in Annexure I of the official advertisement.

Candidates can indicate their preferred examination centre while applying, subject to the options provided by the application form. However, Indian Bank may allot a different centre according to availability.

Requests for examination centre changes will not be entertained. Candidates must bear their own examination-related travel expenses.

Indian Bank Apprentice Admit Card 2026

Indian Bank will issue examination call letters through its official website or other recruitment-related portals identified in the notification.

Candidates must download their call letters using the registration number or roll number and the required login credentials.

Call letters will not be sent by post. Applicants should regularly check their registered email and the official bank recruitment website for examination updates.

Indian Bank Apprentice Certificate and Contract Conditions

Selected candidates will receive a digital apprenticeship engagement offer through NATS 2.0. The apprenticeship contract is normally for 12 months and terminates automatically after completion of the prescribed training period.

Candidates must report at the allotted bank branch or training venue on the specified joining date. Failure to report may lead to termination of the apprenticeship contract.

Early Termination of Apprenticeship

The advertisement specifies conditions for early termination of the apprenticeship contract, including voluntary withdrawal, misconduct, employment elsewhere and medical inability to continue training.

A candidate who voluntarily leaves the training before completing the contract may be required to pay an amount equivalent to one month's stipend, under the notified conditions.

Separate provisions apply to termination after securing gainful employment or due to medical grounds. Candidates should read the full contractual conditions before accepting the apprenticeship.

Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Indian Bank has announced 1,500 apprenticeship training seats for FY 2026-27.
  • Online applications are open from 5 November to 25 November 2026.
  • Graduation in any discipline is required.
  • Graduation must have been completed between 1 April 2022 and 1 November 2026.
  • The age limit is 20 to 28 years as on 1 November 2026, with applicable relaxation.
  • Candidates with one year or more of post-qualification work experience are not eligible.
  • Applicants who have already undergone apprenticeship training are ineligible.
  • Only one State/UT can be selected.
  • Candidates must maintain a fully completed NATS 2.0 profile.
  • The application fee is Rs. 800 or Rs. 175 plus GST, depending on category.
  • Selection includes a 100-mark online test and Local Language Proficiency Test.
  • The bank may conduct an interview at its discretion.
  • Local language exemption is available with the prescribed school-study evidence.
  • The stipend depends on whether the allotted branch is Metro/Urban or Rural/Semi-Urban.
  • Training lasts for 12 months.
  • Apprenticeship does not guarantee regular or contractual employment.
  • Ex-Servicemen and Disabled Ex-Servicemen are not eligible under the notification.
  • Candidates must satisfy document verification and medical fitness requirements.
  • The bank may revise the training seats, selection requirements or schedule through official updates.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Satish Dhawan Space Centre SHAR (SDSC SHAR), under the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), has issued an apprenticeship notification dated 06 November 2026 for 400 Apprentice positions in various disciplines and trades. The opportunities are available for Engineering Graduates, Non-Engineering Graduates, Technician Apprentices, Diploma in Commercial and Computer Practice (DCCP), Trade Apprentices and Vocational Apprentices.

The ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 online application process is scheduled from 06 November 2026 to 26 November 2026. Candidates with relevant B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Com, B.A., Diploma, ITI/NTC or vocational qualifications can check their eligibility and apply through the prescribed apprenticeship registration portal and UMANG portal. Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 9,600 to Rs. 12,300 during the 12-month apprenticeship training period.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview

SDSC SHAR, Sriharikota, is inviting applications for apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Amendment Act, 1973. Candidates should review the notification carefully before registration because eligibility, educational qualifications and monthly stipends differ by apprenticeship category.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 Important Dates

Applicants should complete the required apprenticeship portal registration before submitting their applications through UMANG.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Vacancy 2026

ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026

Applicants must possess the educational qualifications prescribed for their apprenticeship category. Engineering and Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentices require the relevant degree, while Technician, Trade and Vocational Apprentices must possess the specified diploma, trade or vocational qualification.

Category Educational Qualification
Engineering Graduate Apprentice B.E./B.Tech in the relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentice B.Sc in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Electronics or Computer Science, or B.Com/B.A. from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
Technician Apprentice Diploma in the relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
Trade Apprentice SSLC/SSC with ITI/NTC in the relevant trade from NCVT.
Vocational Apprentice Certificate in the relevant vocational course involving two years of study after secondary school education, recognized by AICTE.

Important Eligibility Conditions: Graduate and Diploma Apprenticeship candidates must have passed their relevant qualifications in 2022 or later. Applicants with sandwich-course certificates, short-term/certificate courses or those pursuing higher studies are not eligible under the stated conditions.

Candidates who have already completed or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training, have one year or more of experience in an organization, or have been terminated from or withdrawn from apprenticeship training are also not eligible. Only Indian nationals may apply.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Age Limit 2026

The uploaded apprenticeship notification does not specify a separate minimum or maximum numerical age limit. Candidates should follow the eligibility requirements under the applicable apprenticeship rules and the official application portals. Applicants should not assume an age relaxation or upper age limit unless it is officially prescribed.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Salary / Stipend 2026

Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend according to their category during the prescribed training period. The highest specified stipend is Rs. 12,300 per month for Graduate Apprentices, while Trade and Vocational Apprentices receive Rs. 9,600 per month.

Note: The notification lists DCCP as a separate vacancy category but does not separately specify its stipend in the educational qualification and stipend table. Candidates should verify the applicable amount through SDSC SHAR.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Application Fee 2026

The official notification does not prescribe a separate application fee amount. Candidates should refer to the official apprenticeship registration portals for any applicable instructions before submitting their applications.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Selection Process 2026

Selection for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprenticeship 2026 will be based on academic merit and document verification. The notification provides for category-wise merit lists using the marks obtained in the relevant educational qualification. It does not announce a separate written examination or interview as part of the stated selection procedure.

  1. Academic Merit List: Merit lists will be prepared based on academic scores separately for UR, OBC, SC, ST and EWS categories.
  2. Discipline-Wise Shortlisting: Applicants will be shortlisted according to their position in the merit list for the relevant discipline, branch, trade or subject.
  3. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend document verification with original certificates.
  4. Final Consideration: Only candidates who attend verification and satisfy all prescribed eligibility requirements will be considered for apprenticeship engagement.

No travelling allowance will be provided to candidates attending document verification. Selection is subject to satisfactory verification of qualifications, marks and supporting documents.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 Training Duration

The apprenticeship training duration is 12 months, commencing from the execution of the apprenticeship contract. Selected candidates must execute the contract in accordance with the Apprentices Act and submit a medical fitness certificate at the time of joining.

Completion of apprenticeship training does not provide any claim to temporary, ad hoc or permanent employment at SDSC SHAR or any other ISRO/Department of Space centre or unit.

How to Apply Online for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Candidates must complete the prescribed apprenticeship registration before applying for the SDSC SHAR apprenticeship through the UMANG portal. The official notification provides the following procedure.

  1. Visit the NATS portal at nats.education.gov.in or the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme portal at www.apprenticeship.gov.in, as applicable.
  2. Register on the appropriate apprenticeship portal using the required details and upload the applicable Degree/Diploma certificate and valid government-issued identification documents.
  3. After successful registration, retain the generated Enrolment Number or Apprenticeship Registration Number.
  4. Ensure that your Aadhaar number is linked to your bank account and enabled for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
  5. Visit the UMANG portal at web.umang.gov.in/landing/.
  6. Register or log in to UMANG and search for SDSC SHAR Apprenticeship.
  7. Select the appropriate apprenticeship position and enter the required details.
  8. Upload the relevant supporting documents in JPG, JPEG or PNG format, not exceeding 1 MB per document, as specified in the notification.
  9. Upload the required photograph, signature and category certificates in the format prescribed on UMANG.
  10. Carefully verify the educational qualification, marks, passing year, category and other details before submitting the application.
  11. Submit the online application on or before 26 November 2026 and retain a copy for future reference.

Important: No changes will be permitted after final submission. Applications submitted through any mode other than the prescribed online portal will not be accepted.

Documents Required for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026

Candidates should prepare the documents applicable to their apprenticeship category before beginning registration. The notification requires relevant educational certificates, identification documents and supporting category documents, where applicable.

  • Intermediate Certificate, where applicable
  • ITI / NTC Certificate, where applicable

  • B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Com or B.A. Certificates and Marksheets, where applicable

  • Valid SC/ST/OBC Certificate, if applicable
  • EWS Income and Asset Certificate valid for 2026-27, if applicable
  • PwBD Certificate and Unique Disability Identity Card, if applicable
  • NATS / Apprenticeship Registration Number

Job Location Northern Railway

About RRC NR

The Railway Recruitment Cell, Northern Railway conducts this recruitment for posts in Northern Railway against the Scouts & Guides quota for the year 2026-27. The notice is signed by the Chairman, Railway Recruitment Cell, Northern Railway, and the recruitment follows the Railway Board's policy in Master Circular No. 07 dated 13/12/2019, read with later amendments. The RRC website www.rrcnr.org is named as the main source of information for candidates during the selection.

Vacancy Details

The notice gives 27 posts in total. No post is reserved for SC, ST or OBC; candidates of these categories get only the age relaxation admissible in open market recruitment.

Sl. No. Post Pay Level Vacancy
1 Group 'C' Level 2 of Pay Matrix 7th CPC of RS(RP) rules,2016 05
2 Group 'D' (Erstwhile) Level 1 of Pay Matrix 7th CPC of RS(RP) rules,2016 22
Total 27

A candidate may apply for both Level 1 and Level 2 if eligible, but must submit a separate application form with a separate examination fee for each. Separate examinations will be held for the two levels, tentatively on the same day in two shifts.

Who Can Apply

Applications are invited from eligible Indian citizens. Each post needs an educational qualification and the same scouting qualification. No relaxation in the educational or Scouts & Guides qualification is permitted, and both must be held at the time of applying.

Group 'C' (Level 2) – Educational Qualification

  • Passed 12th (+2 stage) from a recognized board or its equivalent examination with not less than 50% marks in the aggregate. The 50% marks are not insisted upon for SC / ST / Ex-servicemen for NTPC categories and for candidates with higher qualification such as graduation/post graduation.
  • OR Passed Matriculation from a recognized board plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship for Technician categories.
  • OR Passed Matriculation from a recognized board plus ITI approved by NCVT/SCVT for technician categories.

Group 'D' (Erstwhile) (Level 1) – Educational Qualification

  • 10th passed + National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT
  • OR 10th pass + ITI
  • OR 10th Pass or ITI or equivalent or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT

Scouting Qualification (Both Posts)

  • A President Scouts/Guide/Rover/Ranger OR Himalaya Wood Badge (HWB) holder in any section.
  • Should have been an active member of a Scouts organization for the last 5 years, with the Certificate of Activeness as per Annexure-I (signed by the Group Leader, DOC and DC of Scouts/Guides). This certificate must be issued on or after the date of publication of the notification.
  • Should have attended two events at National level OR All Indian Railway's level and two events at State level.

Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

Age Limit (as on 01.01.2027)

The lower and upper age limits will be reckoned as on 01/01/2027. A 10th/Matriculation or equivalent certificate showing the date of birth is mandatory; otherwise the application will be rejected.

Post UR OBC SC/ST
Group 'C' (Level 2) 18 to 30 Years 18 to 33 Years 18 to 35 Years
Group 'D' (Erstwhile) (Level 1) 18 to 33 Years 18 to 36 Years 18 to 38 Years

Commenced Act Apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act before age 25 UR 35, OBC-NCL 38, SC/ST 40 years of age

Pay and Tenure

  • Group 'C' is in Level 2 and Group 'D' (Erstwhile) in Level 1 of the Pay Matrix, 7th CPC, of RS(RP) Rules, 2016. All recruitments against open advertisement quota will be at the minimum of the scale of pay in the Pay Matrix.
  • Probation: as per extant rules.
  • Training: the selected candidate must undergo training as required for the post.
  • Persons appointed as Clerks must acquire typing proficiency within two years of appointment; their appointment stays provisional until then, and without it their services will be summarily terminated.
  • Specific post and place of posting will be decided by the Northern Railway administration at the time of appointment. Selected candidates may be transferred to any department, division/unit or establishment over Northern Railway in the exigencies of service.
  • Candidates who finally qualify must sign a declaration (Annexure-III) to undergo Unit Leader Training within 1 year of posting, open and/or run a Unit, undergo progressive training and assist the Railway scout administration; violation may lead to action under the D&A Rules.

How to Apply for RRC NR Recruitment 2026

  1. Go to the RRC website www.rrcnr.org between 6 November 2026 and 6 December 2026.
  2. Click the box at the end of the notification to give the undertaking that you have read the notification and will comply with its instructions.
  3. Click APPLY ONLINE and choose Login for Already Registered Candidates or New Registration.
  4. Complete the dashboard parts: Part I Registration Form, Part II Application Form, Part III Payment of Examination Fee, Part IV Uploading Documents, photo, sign and thumb impression, Part V Online Payment Details Print, Part VI Application Details/Print. The parts can be done in one go or in stages, but must be completed by the last date.
  5. Upload a photograph in full Scout & Guide uniform (with cap) and the documents listed below.
  6. To apply for both levels, submit a separate application and fee for each.

Candidates having difficulty in registering online may contact the helpline numbers available on the RRC website.

Application Fee

Category Fee
All candidates except those listed below Rs. 500/- (Rs. 400 refunded after deducting bank charges on appearing in the written examination/CBT)
SC/ST/Ex-Serviceman/Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), Transgender/Women, Minorities and Economically Backward Classes Rs. 250/- (refunded after deducting bank charges to those who actually appear in the written examination)

The fee is paid only online in favour of RRC/NR; cash, cheque, money order, IPO, demand draft and fee stamps are not accepted. A refund goes back to the account the fee came from, so candidates should pay from their own account. For an incomplete or pending transaction, a fresh transaction is needed. 'Minority' means Muslims, Christians, Buddhists, Zoroastrians (Parsis) and Sikhs. Economically Backward Classes means family income below Rs. 50,000/- per annum, shown by an income certificate in the Annexure-'E' format on the letterhead of an authorised issuer (District Magistrate or Revenue Officer up to Tehsildar, sitting Lok Sabha or Rajya Sabha MP, BPL card or Central Government poverty programme certificate or Izzat MST, or a Union Minister's recommendation).

Documents to Upload

  • Proof of date of birth (10th or Matric pass certificate)
  • Proof of minimum essential educational and scouting qualification prescribed for the post
  • Certificate in prescribed format for SC/ST/OBC/Minority/Economically Backward/PWD candidates (self-attested caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC)
  • Scanned self-attested President Scout/Guide/Rover/Ranger or HWB certificate and parchment
  • Certificate of Activeness issued on or after the date of the notification
  • Photograph in full Scout & Guide uniform (with cap), signature and thumb impression

Selection and Interview

Eligible candidates will be called for a written examination (Computer Based Test/Tablet Based Test); those who qualify undergo Document Verification, and the panel is formed on merit of the written examination and the marks on certificates. Candidates recommended for appointment must pass the prescribed medical fitness standards.

Part Component Marks
(A) Written Test/CBT/TBT (60 minutes): 40 objective questions (40 marks) and 1 essay question (20 marks) on Scouts & Guides organisation and activities and General Knowledge 60
(B)(i) National Events/National Jamboree (including All Indian Railway Events): first two certificates NIL, one additional event 07, two or more 10 10
(B)(ii) State Events/Rallies: first two certificates NIL, one additional event 07, two or more 10 10
(B)(iii) Specialized Scouts/Guides course at National/State/All Indian Railways level: one course 07, two or more 10 10
(B)(iv) District Rallies: one certificate NIL, two certificates 07, three certificates 10 10
Total 100
  • The examination is in Hindi or English.
  • Negative marking: 1/3rd of the marks for the question deducted for every wrong objective answer.
  • Minimum 40% marks in the written examination are needed for the next stage; relaxation for reserved categories as per Railway Board's rules.
  • Candidates equal to 5 times the notified vacancies will be called for Document Verification on merit.
  • Written Examination and Document Verification will be held in Delhi only.

The syllabus (Annexure-II) covers History of Scouting/Guiding; Law & Promise; organisation at district, state and national level; training centres; Scouting for Boys/Guiding for Girls in India; motto, left hand shake, salute, prayer, flag song, National Anthem and flags; social services; hiking; proficiency badges; stages in Scouting/Guiding; Thinking Day; progressive training; pioneering; handicrafts; Indian Railway Jamborette, National Jamboree and Jamboree on the Air; WAGGGS/WOSM; Uprashtrapati Award and Prime Minister Shield competitions; community development programmes; and the aims and methods of Scouting.

Important Dates

Event Date
Publication of detailed notification on RRC website 04.11.2026
Start of online application 06.11.2026
Closing of online application 06.12.2026
Expected date of online written examination January 2027

Important Instructions

  • Bring all uploaded documents in original with one set of self-attested photocopies on the day of Document Verification; certificates not in English or Hindi need a self-attested translation.
  • Serving employees of Central/State Government, Railways or PSUs may apply directly after informing their employer, and must produce a No Objection Certificate on the date of Document Verification.
  • No TA/DA or accommodation is given; candidates bring their own Scout & Guide uniform/kit. SC/ST candidates who uploaded a proper community certificate get free 2nd class travel authority with the E-Admit Card, and must carry the original SC/ST certificate and identity proof while travelling.
  • Shortlisted candidates may need to stay more than one day at the venue at their own arrangement.
  • Applications are rejected for missing photograph, signature or fee, less fee, missing proofs, wrong date of birth, over or under age, or filing in a language other than English or Hindi.
  • Candidates debarred for life from RRB/RRC examinations, or debarred for a period not yet over, need not apply.
  • Candidates with a higher qualification who apply for the lower level are considered for the level applied for.
  • Impersonation, forged certificates or canvassing lead to rejection and debarment; jurisdiction for legal disputes is New Delhi only.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

WAPCOS Limited, a Government of India Undertaking, has released a notice to engage Experts on a project-term basis. WAPCOS describes itself as an ISO 9001:2015, "Mini Ratna-I" organization. The engagement is for work relating to various Power Transmission, Distribution and Solar Projects in India and abroad.

The notice lists 9 posts for Indian Projects and 17 posts for Overseas Projects (Africa Region), which is 26 posts in total. Interested candidates have to send their CV to [email protected] on or before 15.11.2026 (Extended).

Quick Summary

  • Who is recruiting? WAPCOS Limited (A Government of India Undertaking).
  • Which posts? Transmission Expert, Civil Expert, Procurement & Contract Expert, Project Manager, Solar Power Plant Expert, Project Accountant, Office Assistant and other posts listed below.
  • How many vacancies? 11 for Indian Projects and 18 for Overseas Projects (Africa Region), 29 in total as per the vacancies listed against each post. The notice also states that the number of posts is variable and will be decided as per project requirements.
  • Who can apply? Candidates meeting the post-wise qualification and experience conditions, with a maximum age of 67 years as on 01.10.2026.
  • Application start date: Not specified in the notification. The notice is dated 23.10.2026.
  • Last date: 15.11.2026 (Extended).
  • Application mode: Send CV by email to [email protected], using the WAPCOS format.
  • Job location: Place of posting will be finalized at the time of engagement. Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere in India or abroad.

WAPCOS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility depends on the post. Each post has its own qualification and experience requirement, given in the next section. The common conditions in the notification are:

  • The maximum age limit for engagement of Consultants is 67 years. Age and experience will be counted as on 01.10.2026.
  • Applications must be in the WAPCOS format only. Applications in other formats will be rejected.
  • Applications must be in the prescribed proforma along with self-attested photocopies of documents in support of Date of birth, Qualification, Experience and Proof of category etc.
  • Those working in Govt. Departments/PSU/Autonomous bodies are required to produce a no objection/relieving certificate at the time of joining.

WAPCOS Recruitment 2026 Qualification and Experience

The qualification and experience conditions are given below as stated in the notification, post by post.

Indian Projects

1. Transmission Expert (1 vacancy)

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or equivalent from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • Transmission Line Engineer shall have a professional work record of not less than 10 years in planning, designing, managing, quality assurance and supervising transmission line with voltage levels of minimum 220kV. Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 3 years.
  • Shall have experience of not less than 10 years in survey of transmission line at voltage level of minimum 220kV. Experience of Stringing of conductor, erection of special and multi circuit tower and pile foundation in river crossing will be preferred.

2. Civil Expert (Transmission & Substation) (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Bachelor or higher degree in civil engineering or equivalent from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • The engineer should preferably have minimum 10 years of relevant experience in designing, quality monitoring and supervising of transmission line and Substations civil foundation works with voltage levels covering 132kV and upward up to 220kV. Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 3 years.
  • The expert shall have an understanding of High Voltage Transmission line clearances and safety considerations and knowledge on AutoCAD or similar software.
  • Should be well conversant with methods and tools involved in the construction or repair of buildings or other structures and specially the different types of foundation involves in transmission lines including pile and well foundation.

3. Procurement & Contract Expert (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Post graduate degree in Engineering or equivalent from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • The Procurement and Contract Expert shall have an professional work record of not less than 10 years in managing procurement and contract management for works of construction of transmission lines and substations of voltage level upto 220kV.
  • Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 3 years for any Externally Aided Project.
  • Expert should be well conversant with the procurement guidelines and procedures of the externally aided project. Expert having certification from MDBs, will be preferable.

4. Sr. Environmental Safeguard Expert (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Master's degree in Environmental Science/Environmental Management/Environmental Engineering or in similar field from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • 10 years of demonstrated experience in preparation and implementation of EIA/ESIAs and EMP/ESMPs for assessment, management and monitoring environmental and social risks and impacts in linear Infrastructure projects. The expert should be conversant with the Environmental Codes of Practice in the context of Govt. of India. The expert should also be conversant with the environmental and social policies of Multilateral Development Banks (MDBs).
  • Experience in overseeing Energy Infrastructure projects will be an added advantage.
  • Must have experience of working in at least two Externally Aided Projects for overall period of minimum 5 years.
  • Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 5 years.

5. Sr. Social Safeguard Expert (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Master's degree in Social Science / Social Work / Social Management or similar field from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • 10 years of demonstrated experience in preparation and implementation of social assessments and management plans, resettlement action plan/Tribal Development Plan, Livelihood assessment and restoration plan etc. in linear Infrastructure projects. The expert should also be conversant with the social policies of Govt. of India and Multilateral Development Banks (MDBs).
  • Experience in overseeing Energy Infrastructure projects will be an added advantage.
  • Must have experience of working in at least two Externally Aided Projects for overall period of minimum 5 years.
  • Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 5 years.

6. Occupational, Health & Safety Officer (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Degree / P.G. Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety/ Industrial safety or equivalent from any recognized Institution.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Occupational, Health and Safety management. The officer should be well conversant with the safety policies and regulations adopted by the MDB funded linear infrastructure projects and should have minimum 3 years' experience.
  • Moreover, the expert having experience of working under PMC services/consultant will be an added advantage.

7. Environmental Investigation Officer (3 vacancies)

Qualification: M.Sc. in Environmental Science or in relevant field from recognized institution.

Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience of working on environment related aspects of transmission line and substation construction projects of 132kV/220kV level. The experience in projects funded by Multilateral Development Banks shall be preferred.

8. Project Accountant (1 vacancy)

Qualification: B.Com. from recognized institution.

Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in accounting of power transmission and distribution sector infrastructure development projects. The experience in projects funded by Multilateral Development Banks shall be preferred.

9. Office Assistant (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Any Graduate Degree from recognized institution.

Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in assisting office works related to power transmission and distribution sector infrastructure development projects.

Overseas Projects (Africa Region)

1. Project Manager (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • At least Ten (10) years' experience in managing/implementation/ design & supervision of Distribution Network Refurbishment and Strengthening and Last Mile connection projects or similar projects.
  • The project Manager shall have managed at least three (3) projects of similar nature within last ten (10) years.

2. Distribution Substation Engineer (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized institution.

Experience:

  • At least ten (10) years' experience in the design, testing, installation, and commissioning of indoor and outdoor substations and switchgear.
  • The Distribution Substation Engineer shall have worked on at least two (2) projects of similar nature and scope within the last seven (7) years.
  • Registration with a recognized professional body will be an added advantage.

3. Distribution Line Engineer (Electrical) (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized institution.

Experience:

  • At least ten (10) years' experience in the design, testing, installation, and commissioning of medium voltage and low voltage distribution systems, pole-mounted and ground-mounted transformers, and last mile connections.
  • The Distribution Line Engineer shall have worked on at least two (2) projects of similar nature and scope within the last seven (7) years, including large-scale roll-out of electricity connections.
  • Registration with a recognized professional body will be an added advantage.

4. Renewable Energy Engineer, BESS specialist (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Master's degree in Renewable Energy Engineering or equivalent from recognized institution.

Experience: At least twelve (12) years of experience in studies / control / implementation on projects for the construction of solar photovoltaic systems, including at least seven (07) years of experience on projects for the construction of ground-mounted solar photovoltaic power plants, connected to the HTB or HTA electricity network.

Must have achieved at least over the last seven (07) years:

  • Two (02) execution/control and supervision missions for construction projects for a photovoltaic solar power plant of at least 20 MWc with BESS storage of at least 20 MWh, connected to an HTB or HTA, electricity network.
  • Two (02) detailed technical study or technical assistance missions relating to photovoltaic solar power plant construction projects with BESS storage, connected to an HTB or HTA electricity network.
  • Having experience in control and supervision missions or detailed technical study or technical assistance relating to BESS storage projects of at least 20 MWh, connected to an HTB or HTA electricity network would be an asset.
  • Having a good knowledge of the environmental and social standards of the World Bank and the IFC would be an asset.

5. Solar Power Plant Expert (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Masters Degree in Renewable Energy Engineer level or equivalent from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • At least twelve (12) years of experience in studies / control / implementation on photovoltaic solar system construction projects, including at least seven (07) years in photovoltaic solar power plant projects connected to the HTB or HTA electricity network.
  • Must have achieved at least over the last seven (07) years following tasks:
    • Three (03) execution/control and supervision missions for construction projects for a photovoltaic solar power plant of at least 20 MWc connected to an HTB or HTA electricity network.
    • One (01) detailed technical study or technical assistance mission relating to projects for the construction of a photovoltaic solar power plant of at least 20 MWc connected to an HTB or HTA electricity network.
  • Having a good knowledge of the environmental and social standards of the World Bank and the IFC would be an asset.
  • Will be responsible for coordinating all activities related to the construction of the solar power plant.

6. Civil Engineer (Solar Power Plant) (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Bachelor's degree in civil engineering or equivalent from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • At least seven (07) years of experience in studies / control / implementation on civil engineering construction projects, including at least five (05) years on photovoltaic solar power plant projects connected to the HTB or HTA electricity network.
  • Must have carried out at least over the last seven (07) years: two (02) missions of control and supervision of civil engineering works relating to the construction of a photovoltaic solar power plant of at least 10 MWc connected to an HTB or HTA electricity network, as works controller.

7. Transmission Expert (1 vacancy)

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or equivalent from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • Transmission Line Engineer shall have a professional work record of not less than 10 years in planning, designing, managing, quality assurance and supervising transmission line with voltage levels of 132kV and above. Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 3 years.
  • Shall have experience of not less than 10 years in survey of transmission line at voltage level of minimum 132kV. Experience of Stringing of conductor, erection of special and multi circuit tower and pile foundation in river crossing will be preferred.
  • The expert shall have worked on at least three (3) projects of similar nature in the last ten (10) years.

8. Project Manager (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Bachelor or master's degree in electrical engineering from recognized institution. Post-Graduation in Project Management / Planning / Engineering/ Administration will be an advantage.

Experience:

  • 15 years' experience in Electrical Power Systems; ten (10) years' experience in Distribution Power Network Construction of up to 66 kV and seven (7) years' experience in Project Management.
  • The Project Manager shall have experience in leading/Managing the implementation of at least three (3) Distribution projects of up to 33kV during the last ten (10) years. Minimum two (2) projects shall be of international turnkey contracts funded by international funding institutions (IFIs).
  • The Project Manager shall be fluent in Portuguese with working knowledge of English and shall have worked in Sub Saharan Africa region.

9. Social and Gender Specialist (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Diploma in Social Sciences from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • Shall have minimum five (5) years' of working experience in Social Development and Stakeholder Engagement.
  • The social specialist shall have experience in similar projects of Social Development, in E&S risks and impacts assessment and management, particularly related to public civil works, so as experience in dealing with community conflicts mediation and Grievance Redress Mechanisms (GRM).
  • Experience in assess and address GBV risks and challenges will be an asset and in Communication for Development and Behaviour Change an advantage.
  • Shall have professional experience in Africa and shall have language proficiency in Portuguese.
  • The specialist should provide training and guidance to the Social and Gender assistants.

10. Distribution Engineer (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Minimum Degree in Electrical Engineering from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • Minimum ten (10) years of experience in design and construction of distribution system projects up to 66 kV.
  • The Distribution Engineer shall demonstrate expertise of working in similar projects and conducting, design and test of equipment of LV distribution system including household connection as well as of MV system.
  • Shall have experience of working in minimum two (2) projects funded by International Funding Institutions experience.
  • The Distribution Engineer shall be fluent in Portuguese with working knowledge of English and shall have worked in Sub Saharan Africa region.

11. General Site Supervisor (1 vacancy)

Qualification: Minimum Degree in Electrical Engineering from recognized institution.

Experience:

  • Minimum 15 years of general experience.
  • Shall have minimum ten (10) years in project supervision/coordination; shall have participated in minimum three (3) contracts as project supervisor and two (2) projects should have been financed by International Financial Institutions.
  • The General Site Supervisor shall be fluent in Portuguese with working knowledge of English and shall have worked in Sub Saharan Africa region.

12. Resident Project Manager (1 vacancy)

Qualification: B.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering or related fields from a recognized university.

Experience:

  • 15 years of experience in power system infrastructure construction, design, project implementation, and construction supervision.
  • Project Manager experience in at least one distribution network construction project in developing countries.
  • Good working knowledge of the English language.

Candidates with a recognized Bachelor's degree in the prescribed engineering discipline and a qualifying GATE 2025 score can apply. Yes. All applicants must have qualified in GATE 2025 in the paper corresponding to their notified engineering discipline.

Can Candidates with Part-Time Engineering Degrees Apply?

Yes. The advertisement expressly accepts full-time and part-time Bachelor's degrees in the listed engineering branches, provided the qualifications are recognized and all other eligibility conditions are satisfied.

Can Final-Year Engineering Students Apply?

No. Candidates must have passed the prescribed qualification by 1 November 2026. Applicants awaiting final results after that date are not eligible.

How Are Candidates Shortlisted for the Interview?

Eligible candidates will be shortlisted separately for each recruitment area based on their GATE 2025 marks, generally in a ratio of 1:6 or 1:10 against the notified vacancies, as applicable.

The merit list for Area-1, Area-2, Area-3 and Area-4 will be prepared independently, ensuring the applicable reservation provisions.

How Is the Final Merit List Prepared?

The final merit list will be prepared using the total marks obtained out of 100, combining the weighted GATE 2025 score and Personal Interview marks.

If candidates obtain equal final scores at the cut-off, the older candidate will be placed higher. If the tie continues, the alphabetical order of the candidate's first name will be considered.

Is There a Separate Written Examination?

The advertisement does not prescribe a separate NLCIL written examination. The recruitment uses GATE 2025 scores followed by a Personal Interview, document verification and a pre-employment medical examination.

The educational qualification differs substantially across the seven posts. Applicants must meet the specific academic and professional requirements listed in Annexure A by 4 December 2026.

RRB Isolated Category Post-Wise Educational Qualification

Post Name Essential Qualification
Chief Law Assistant University Degree in Law with 3 Years Standing Practice as a Pleader at Bar. Serving Railway Law Graduates with at Least 5 Years of Railway Service May Also Qualify Under the Notified Provision.
Public Prosecutor Bachelor's Degree in Law from a Recognized University with 5 Years Standing as an Advocate at Bar.
Senior Publicity Inspector Degree from a Recognized University and Diploma in Public Relations, Advertising, Journalism or Mass Communication. Two Years' Relevant Experience Is Desirable.
Junior Translator (Hindi) Relevant Master's Degree Meeting the Notified Hindi/English Language Combination, Plus Recognized Translation Diploma/Certificate or 2 Years' Government Translation Experience.
Staff and Welfare Inspector Graduation with Prescribed Diploma or Degree Qualification in Labour Welfare, Labour Laws, Personnel Management or Human Resource Management.
Scientific Assistant (Training) Master's Degree in Psychology with at Least 50% Aggregate Marks.
Lab Assistant Grade III 12th Standard (+2) or Equivalent with Physics and Chemistry as Science Subjects.

Chief Law Assistant Eligibility

Candidates must possess a university degree in Law and have at least three years of standing practice as a Pleader at Bar.

Serving Railway employees with a Law degree may also apply if they have completed at least five years of service in any branch of Railway Administration, subject to the notification's conditions.

Public Prosecutor Eligibility

Applicants must have a recognized Bachelor's degree in Law and five years of standing as an Advocate at Bar.

Important: A Law degree alone is not sufficient. The prescribed professional practice requirement must also be satisfied.

Senior Publicity Inspector Eligibility

Candidates need a recognized university degree together with a Diploma in Public Relations, Advertising, Journalism or Mass Communication from a recognized institution or university.

Two years of experience in a relevant field is desirable, not mandatory.

RRB Junior Translator (Hindi) Eligibility 2026

Junior Translator applicants must satisfy one of the prescribed Master's degree language combinations involving Hindi and English, along with an additional translation qualification or experience.

The academic requirement may be fulfilled through a recognized Master's degree in Hindi or English with the other language as a compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination at degree level, or through the alternative Master's degree language combinations specified in Annexure A.

In addition, candidates must possess either:

  • A recognized Diploma or Certificate Course in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa; or
  • Two years of translation experience between Hindi and English in Central or State Government offices, including Government of India undertakings.

Important: A general Master's degree or Hindi/English language proficiency alone does not automatically satisfy this post's eligibility conditions.

Staff and Welfare Inspector Eligibility

Applicants must have graduation along with at least one of the following qualifications:

  • Diploma in Labour or Social Welfare.
  • Diploma in Labour Laws.
  • LLB with papers in Labour Laws.
  • Postgraduate Diploma in Personnel Management.
  • MBA with papers in Personnel Management.
  • MBA in Human Resources.
  • Postgraduate Diploma in Human Resource Management with relevant Personnel Management papers from a Government-recognized institution.

Scientific Assistant (Training) Eligibility

Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Psychology with at least 50% marks in aggregate.

Specialization in Industrial, Organisational or Clinical Psychology; experience in counselling or guidance programmes; and working computer knowledge are desirable qualifications.

RRB Lab Assistant Grade III Eligibility

Candidates must have passed Class 12 (+2 Stage) or an equivalent examination with Physics and Chemistry as subjects.

This is the only post category in CEN 09/2026 for which the stated essential educational qualification is at the 12th-standard level.

Can Final-Year Students Apply?

No. Candidates awaiting their final examination results for the prescribed essential qualification are not eligible. The required qualification must have been obtained by 4 December 2026.

RRB Isolated Category Age Limit 2026

The minimum age is 18 years for all seven categories. The upper age limit varies between 30 and 40 years, calculated as on 1 January 2027.

Junior Translator (Hindi) 18 Years 33 Years

Scientific Assistant (Training) 18 Years 35 Years
Lab Assistant Grade III 18 Years 30 Years

PwBD - SC / ST 15 Years

Eligible Serving Railway Group C / Former Group D Employees Maximum Age up to 40 / 43 / 45 Years Depending on Category
Eligible Widowed / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women Not Remarried Maximum Age 35 / 38 / 40 Years Depending on Category

Important: When a candidate qualifies for age relaxation under more than one provision, the maximum applicable relaxation is allowed rather than automatically adding different relaxations together. Detailed conditions are given in Section 5.2 of the notification.

RRB Isolated Category Salary 2026

The initial basic pay ranges from Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 44,900 under the 7th Central Pay Commission, depending on the post and pay level.

RRB Isolated Category Post-Wise Salary

Staff and Welfare Inspector Level 6 Rs. 35,400
Scientific Assistant (Training) Level 6 Rs. 35,400
Lab Assistant Grade III Level 2 Rs. 19,900

Salary Clarification: The figures are initial basic pay, not monthly take-home salary. Applicable allowances and deductions will be governed by Railway rules and the employee's posting and service conditions.

RRB Isolated Category Application Fee 2026

The examination fee is Rs. 500 for most candidates and Rs. 250 for the eligible concession categories.

Fee Payment Last Date: 6 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.

Payment Mode: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI. Applicable transaction charges are additional.

RRB Isolated Category Exam Fee Refund 2026

Candidates who appear for the Computer Based Test are eligible for a partial or applicable fee refund after deduction of bank charges.

Category Fee Paid Refund on CBT Attendance
General / OBC / EWS and Other Non-Concession Categories Rs. 500 Rs. 400 Less Bank Charges
SC / ST / Female / PwBD / ExSM / Transgender / Minority / Eligible EBC Rs. 250 Rs. 250 Less Bank Charges

The refund will be credited through the prescribed Aadhaar-seeded bank account mechanism. Candidates who do not appear for the CBT or whose applications are rejected are not entitled to the applicable refund.

Difference Between EBC and EWS in Railway Recruitment

Economically Backward Class (EBC) candidates may qualify for examination fee concession where their annual family income is below Rs. 50,000 and they satisfy the documentary requirements.

Economically Weaker Section (EWS) is a separate category used for reservation under applicable Government rules.

Claiming EBC fee concession does not automatically provide EWS reservation or an OBC benefit.

RRB Isolated Category Selection Process 2026

The recruitment involves a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by a Translation Test for Junior Translator candidates, where applicable, and subsequent Document Verification and Medical Examination.

  1. Computer Based Test: Eligible candidates appear for the prescribed objective examination.
  2. Translation Test: Junior Translator (Hindi) candidates shortlisted from CBT must qualify in the translation test.
  3. Document Verification: Candidates are shortlisted according to merit, vacancy availability and applicable reservation rules.
  4. Medical Examination: Candidates must meet the medical standards applicable to their selected post.
  5. Final Empanelment: Subject to merit, qualifications, medical fitness and successful verification.

RRBs reserve the right to conduct additional recruitment stages where necessary under the notification.

RRB Isolated Category CBT Exam Pattern 2026

The standard CBT consists of 100 objective questions carrying 100 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes. Eligible candidates using a scribe receive 120 minutes.

Subject Questions Marks

The notified subject-wise distribution is indicative and may vary slightly in the actual question paper.

Category Minimum Qualifying Percentage

EWS 40%
OBC-NCL 30%
